explanations.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to ingest the data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data and to write the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the transformed data from Amazon S3. 错误：AWS DMS 主要用于数据库迁移，而不是实时流式数据处理。 正确：Amazon EMR 可以处理和转换数据，但通常用于批处理而非实时流式数据。 正确：Amazon Athena 可以查询存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to stream the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to transform the data and to write the data to Amazon S3. Use the Amazon RDS query editor to query the transformed data from Amazon S3. 正确：Amazon MSK 是一种托管的 Kafka 服务，适合流式数据处理。 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 可以实时处理和转换数据。 错误：Amazon RDS Query Editor 主要用于查询 RDS 数据库，而不是查询存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。
explanations.E: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to write the data to Amazon S3. Use the Amazon RDS query editor to query the transformed data from Amazon S3. 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 是一种高效的实时数据流工具。 正确：AWS Glue 是一种 ETL 工具，可以转换数据。 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 可以将数据写入 Amazon S3。 错误：Amazon RDS Query Editor 主要用于查询 RDS 数据库，而不是查询存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises volume backup solution that has reached its end of life. The company wants to use AWS as part of a new backup solution and wants to maintain local access to all the data while it is backed up on AWS. The company wants to ensure that the data backed up on AWS is automatically and securely transferred. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Snowball to migrate data out of the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Configure on-premises systems to mount the Snowball S3 endpoint to provide local access to the data.
options.B: Use AWS Snowball Edge to migrate data out of the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Use the Snowball Edge file interface to provide on-premises systems with local access to the data.
options.C: Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a cached volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and configure a percentage of data to cache locally. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local access to the data.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a stored volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and map the gateway storage volumes to on-premises storage. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local access to the data.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Snowball 将数据从本地解决方案迁移到 Amazon S3。配置本地系统挂载 Snowball S3 端点以提供对数据的本地访 问。 错误：AWS Snowball主要用于一次性数据迁移，而不是持痲备份解决方案。 错误：Snowball设备不支持直接挂载S3端点以提供本地访问。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Snowball Edge 将数据从本地解决方案迁移到 Amazon S3。使用 Snowball Edge 文件接口为本地系统提供对数据的 本地访问。 错误：虽然Snowball Edge支持文件接口，但它仍然主要用于数据迁移，而不是持痲备份解决方案。 错误：Snowball Edge不适合长期存储和本地访问场景。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway 并配置一个缓存卷网关。在本地运行 Storage Gateway 软件设备，并配置一部分数据在本地缓 存。挂载网关存储卷以提供对数据的本地访问。 部分正确：缓存卷网关允许将数据存储在Amazon S3，同时在本地缓存部分数据以提高访问速度。 错误：题目要求“维护本地访问到所有数据”，而缓存卷网关只缓存部分数据，无法满足这一要求。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway 并配置一个存储卷网关。在本地运行 Storage Gateway 软件设备，并将网关存储卷映射到本地存 储。挂载网关存储卷以提供对数据的本地访问。 正确：存储卷网关将所有数据存储在本地，同时定期备份到Amazon S3，满足题目要求的“维护本地访问到所有数据”。 正确：存储卷网关支持本地挂载，提供对数据的直接访问。

question: Topic 1 An application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances needs to access an Amazon S3 bucket. Traffic must not traverse the internet. How should a solutions architect configure access to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a private hosted zone by using Amazon Route 53.
options.B: Set up a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
options.C: Configure the EC2 instances to use a NAT gateway to access the S3 bucket.
options.D: Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the VPC and the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Create a private hosted zone by using Amazon Route 53. 错误：Amazon Route 53的私有托管区域用于在VPC内解析域名，但它不能直接实现EC2实例与S3之间的私有连接。 此选项与题目要求无关。
explanations.B: Set up a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. 正确：Gateway VPC Endpoint允许VPC中的资源通过私有网络访问Amazon S3，而无需流量经过互联网。 这是实现EC2实例与S3之间私有连接的最佳解决方案。
explanations.C: Configure the EC2 instances to use a NAT gateway to access the S3 bucket. 错误：NAT Gateway用于将私有子网中的资源连接到互联网或其他AWS服务，但流量仍然会经过互联网。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the VPC and the S3 bucket. 错误：AWS Site-to-Site VPN用于连接本地数据中心与AWS VPC，不能直接用于VPC与S3之间的连接。 此选项与题目要求无关。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company stores terabytes of customer data in the AWS Cloud. The data contains personally identifiable information (PII). The company wants to use the data in three applications. Only one of the applications needs to process the PIl. The PII must be removed before the other two applications process the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create a proxy application layer to intercept and process the data that each application requests.
options.B: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Process and transform the data by using S3 Object Lambda before returning the data to the requesting application.
options.C: Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon S3 buckets so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective S3 bucket.
options.D: Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon DynamoDB tables so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: Store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create a proxy application layer to intercept and process the data that each application requests. 错误：虽然DynamoDB可以存储数据，但它并不适合处理和转换数据。创建一个代理应用程序宔会增加额外的开发和维护工作，导 致较高的操作开销。
explanations.B: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Process and transform the data by using S3 Object Lambda before returning the data to the requesting application. 正确：S3 Object Lambda允许在数据被请求时动嬒处理和转换数据。这种方法无需额外的存储或复杂的应用宔，操作开销最低。
explanations.C: Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon S3 buckets so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective S3 bucket. 错误：虽然这种方法可以满足需求，但需要维护多个S3 bucket，增加了存储和管理的复杂性，操作开销较高。
explanations.D: Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon DynamoDB tables so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective DynamoDB table. 错误：DynamoDB不适合存储大规模的文件数据（如PII数据）。此外，维护多个DynamoDB表也会增加操作开销。

question: Topic 1 A development team has launched a new application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances inside a development VPC. A solutions architect needs to create a new VPC in the same account. The new VPC will be peered with the development VPC. The VPC CIDR block for the development VPC is 192.168.0.0/24. The solutions architect needs to create a CIDR block for the new VPC. The CIDR block must be valid for a VPC peering connection to the development VPC. What is the SMALLEST CIDR block that meets these requirements?

explanations.A: 10.0.1.0/32 - 错误。CIDR块 /32 表示只有一个IP地址，这不符合VPC的最小CIDR块要求（最小为 /28）。此外，/32 的范围太 小，无法满足实际使用需求。
explanations.B: 192.168.0.0/24 - 错误。这个CIDR块与开发VPC的CIDR块完全重叠（192.168.0.0/24），因此无法用于VPC Peering连接。
explanations.C: 192.168.1.0/32 - 错误。CIDR块 /32 表示只有一个IP地址，这不符合VPC的最小CIDR块要求（最小为 /28）。此外，虽然这个地 址与开发VPC的CIDR块不重叠，但范围太小，无法满足实际使用需求。
explanations.D: 10.0.1.0/24 - 正确。这个CIDR块与开发VPC的CIDR块（192.168.0.0/24）没有重叠，并且满足VPC Peering连接的要求。/24 的范 围足够大，适合实际使用。

question: Topic 1 A company deploys an application on five Amazon EC2 instances. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) distributes traffic to the instances by using a target group. The average CPU usage on each of the instances is below 10% most of the time, with occasional surges to 65%. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to automate the scalability of the application. The solution must optimize the cost of the architecture and must ensure that the application has enough CPU resources when surges occur. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters the ALARM state when the CPUUtilization metric is less than 20%. Create an AWS Lambda function that the CloudWatch alarm invokes to terminate one of the EC2 instances in the ALB target group.
options.B: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set a target tracking scaling policy that is based on the ASGAverageCPUUtilization metric. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, the maximum instances to 6, and the target value to 50%. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, and the maximum instances to 6. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Create two Amazon CloudWatch alarms. Configure the first CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization metric is below 20%. Configure the second CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization matric is above 50%. Configure the alarms to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an email message. After receiving the message, log in to decrease or increase the number of EC2 instances that are running.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters the ALARM state when the CPUUtilization metric is less than 20%. Create an AWS Lambda function that the CloudWatch alarm invokes to terminate one of the EC2 instances in the ALB target group. 分析： 此选项试图通过孅动终桬实例来优化成本，但没有考虑到CPU使用率的客值嬦况，无法动嬒扩展实例以应对负载增加。 此外，直接终桬实例可能会导致服务中断，不符合高可用性要求。 错误的解决方案，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set a target tracking scaling policy that is based on the ASGAverageCPUUtilization metric. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, the maximum instances to 6, and the target value to 50%. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group. 分析： 此选项使用了EC2 Auto Scaling组，并配置了目标跟踪扩展策略（Target Tracking Scaling Policy），基于ASGAverageCPUUtilization 指标动嬒调整实例数量。 设置了最小实例数、期望容量和最大实例数，确保了资源的动嬒扩展和成本优化。 解决方案符合题目要求，能够在CPU使用率客值时自动扩展实例，同时优化成本。 正确的解决方案。
explanations.C: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, and the maximum instances to 6. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group. 分析： 此选项创建了EC2 Auto Scaling组，但没有配置目标跟踪扩展策略（Target Tracking Scaling Policy）。 虽然设置了最小实例数、期望容量和最大实例数，但无法根据CPU使用率动嬒调整实例数量。 解决方案不够完整，无法满足题目要求。 错误的解决方案。 Correct Answer: B 正确答案：B Community vote distribution 畱区投畵分害 B (94%) 6% IT正确答案社 区投: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 票分: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 布人: Examtopics
explanations.D: Create two Amazon CloudWatch alarms. Configure the first CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization metric is below 20%. Configure the second CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization metric is above 50%. Configure the alarms to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an email message. After receiving the message, log in to decrease or increase the number of EC2 instances that are running. 分析： 此选项依赖孅动操作来调整实例数量，无法实现自动化扩展。 需要人工寅预，效率低目容易出错，不符合题目要求的自动化解决方案。 错误的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a critical business application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group and access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The design did not pass an operational review because the EC2 instances and the DB instance are all located in a single Availability Zone. A solutions architect must update the design to use a second Availability Zone. Which solution will make the application highly available?

options.A: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.
options.B: Provision two subnets that extend across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.
options.C: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Provision a subnet that extends across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.

explanations.A: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network. 正确点：在每个可用区中配置子网，并将 Auto Scaling 组分害到多个可用区是正确的高可用性设计。 错误点：Amazon RDS 不支持直接配置“与每个网络的连接”。高可用性需要使用 Multi-AZ 部署，而不是孅动配置网络连接。
explanations.B: Provision two subnets that extend across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network. 错误点：子网不能跨多个可用区。每个子网只能宜于一个可用区。 错误点：同样，Amazon RDS 不支持直接配置“与每个网络的连接”。
explanations.C: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment. 正确点：在每个可用区中配置子网是正确的做法。 正确点：将 Auto Scaling 组分害到多个可用区可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 正确点：配置 RDS 为 Multi-AZ 部署是实现数据寑高可用性的推荐方法。
explanations.D: Provision a subnet that extends across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment. 错误点：子网不能跨多个可用区。每个子网只能宜于一个可用区。 正确点：将 Auto Scaling 组分害到多个可用区可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 正确点：配置 RDS 为 Multi-AZ 部署是实现数据寑高可用性的推荐方法。

question: Topic 1 A research laboratory needs to process approximately 8 TB of data. The laboratory requires sub-millisecond latencies and a minimum throughput of 6 GBps for the storage subsystem. Hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux will distribute and process the data. Which solution will meet the performance requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Sat each volume’ tiering policy to ALL. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the fila system on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent SSD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent HDD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume's tiering policy to NONE. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume’s tiering policy to ALL. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances. FSx for NetApp ONTAP支持高性能存储，但其主要适用于企业级文件存储和数据管理场景。 “tiering policy to ALL”会将数据分宔到容量池中，可能会寸响性能，完其是需要高知吐量和低延迟的场景。 此选项无法满足题目中要求的6 GBps知吐量和亚毫秒级延迟。 错误原因：性能不符合要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent SSD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances. FSx for Lustre是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，支持亚毫秒级延迟和高知吐量。 使用持久性SSD存储可以满足6 GBps的知吐量需求。 与Amazon S3集成可以方便地导入和导出数据。 正确原因：完全符合性能要求和场景需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent HDD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances. FSx for Lustre支持高性能计算，但使用HDD存储无法通到6 GBps的知吐量需求。 HDD存储的延迟也较高，不符合亚毫秒级延迟的要求。 错误原因：存储类型性能不足。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume’s tiering policy to NONE. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances. FSx for NetApp ONTAP支持高性能存储，但其主要适用于企业级文件存储和数据管理场景。 虽然“tiering policy to NONE”可以避免分宔存储的性能寸响，但FSx for NetApp ONTAP仍无法通到6 GBps的知吐量需求。 错误原因：性能不符合要求。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to migrate a legacy application from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud because of hardware capacity constraints. The application runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application's database storage continues to grow over time. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon S3.
options.B: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS On- Demand Instances.
options.C: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances.
options.D: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS Reserved Instances.

explanations.A: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon S3. EC2 Spot Instances适合短期、非关键任务的工作负载，但不适合需要24/7运行的应用程序，因为Spot Instances可能会被中断。 Amazon S3是对象存储服务，不适合存储关系型数据库数据。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。
explanations.B: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS On- Demand Instances. EC2 Reserved Instances适合长期运行的应用程序，成本较低，符合要求。 RDS On-Demand Instances成本较高，不是最具性价比的选择。 此选项部分正确，但不是最优解。
explanations.C: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances. EC2 Reserved Instances适合长期运行的应用程序，成本较低，符合要求。 Amazon Aurora是高性能、可扩展的关系型数据库服务，支持自动扩展，目使用Reserved Instances进一步降低成本，符合题目要 求。 此选项是最优解，正确。
explanations.D: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS Reserved Instances. EC2 On-Demand Instances成本较高，不适合长期运行的应用程序。 RDS Reserved Instances成本较低，适合长期运行的数据库，但EC2的选择不符合成本优化要求。 此选项部分正确，但不是最优解。

question: Topic 1 A university research laboratory needs to migrate 30 TB of data from an on-premises Windows file server to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The laboratory has a 1 Gbps network link that many other departments in the university share. The laboratory wants to implement a data migration service that will maximize the performance of the data transfer. However, the laboratory needs to be able to control the amount of bandwidth that the service uses to minimize the impact on other departments. The data migration must take place within the next 5 days. Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: AWS Snowcone
options.B: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.C: AWS DataSync
options.D: AWS Transfer Family

explanations.A: AWS Snowcone 错误：AWS Snowcone是一种物理设备，用于离线数据迁移。虽然它适合小规模数据迁移，但需要时间来运输设备，无法满足5天内 完成迁移的要求。
explanations.B: Amazon FSx File Gateway 错误：FSx File Gateway主要用于将本地文件系统与Amazon FSx集成，适合持续访问文件，但不专门用于大规模数据迁移。
explanations.C: AWS DataSync 正确：AWS DataSync是一种专门设计用于快速、安全地迁移数据的服务。它支持带宽限制功能，可以控制网络使用，适合在共享网 络环境中进行数据迁移。
explanations.D: AWS Transfer Family 错误：AWS Transfer Family主要用于通过SFTP、FTPS或FTP协议传输数据，适合文件级别的传输，但不适合大规模数据迁移。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to create a mobile app that allows users to stream slow-motion video clips on their mobile devices. Currently, the app captures video clips and uploads the video clips in raw format into an Amazon S3 bucket. The app retrieves these video clips directly from the S3 bucket. However, the videos are large in their raw format. Users are experiencing issues with buffering and playback on mobile devices. The company wants to implement solutions to maximize the performance and scalability of the app while minimizing operational overhead. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching. #8 Amazon CloudFront
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AW'S Regions in other S3 buckets.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
options.D: Deploy an Auto Sealing group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching.
options.E: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching. 正确：Amazon CloudFront是一个全球分布式的内容交付网络（CDN），可以显著提高视频流的性能和减少延迟。 它支持缓存内容并优化内容交付，适合解决用户缓冲和播放问题。
explanations.B: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AWS Regions in other S3 buckets. 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移和同桯，而不是优化视频流性能或格式转换。 此选项与题目要求的性能优化和视频播放问题无关。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats. 正确：Amazon Elastic Transcoder是一个专门用于视频格式转换的服务，可以将视频转换为适合移动设备播放的格式。 这可以减少视频文件大小，从而解决缓冲问题。
explanations.D: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching. 错误：使用EC2实例进行内容交付和缓存需要较高的运维开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化运维开销”。 CloudFront是更适合的解决方案。
explanations.E: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats. 错误：虽然EC2实例可以用于视频格式转换，但这需要额外的管理和运维工作。 Amazon Elastic Transcoder是专门的托管服务，运维开销更低，适合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is launching a new application deployed on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster and is using the Fargate launch type for ECS tasks. The company is monitoring CPU and memory usage because it is expecting high traffic to the application upon its launch. However, the company wants to reduce costs when utilization decreases. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale at certain periods based on previous traffic patterns.
options.B: Use an AWS Lambda function to scale Amazon ECS based on metric breaches that trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with simple scaling policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.D: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling with target tracking policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 根据以前的流量模式在特定时间段进行扩展。 错误：EC2 Auto Scaling主要用于管理EC2实例的扩展，而题目明确指出使用的是Fargate launch type，Fargate不依赖EC2实例。 此外，基于“以前的流量模式”进行扩展并不能实时响应当前的流量需求。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数根据触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报的指标超限情况扩展 Amazon ECS。 错误：虽然Lambda可以用来触发扩展，但这不是推荐的方式。AWS Application Auto Scaling已经内置了自动扩展功能，直接使用 它更高效。 使用Lambda函数增加了复杂性，目不符合最佳实践。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 和简单扩展策略，当 ECS 指标超限触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报时进行扩展。 错误：同样的问题，EC2 Auto Scaling适用于EC2实例，而题目使用的是Fargate launch type。 简单扩展策略不如目标跟踪策略棬梮和高效。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Application Auto Scaling 和目标跟踪策略，当 ECS 指标超限触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报时进行扩展。 正确：AWS Application Auto Scaling支持Fargate任务的自动扩展。 目标跟踪策略可以根据CloudWatch指标（如CPU和内存使用率）动态调整任务数量，符合题目需求。

question: Topic 1 A company recently created a disaster recovery site in a different AWS Region. The company needs to transfer large amounts of data back and forth between NFS file systems in the two Regions on a periodic basis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync.
options.B: Use AWS Snowball devices.
options.C: Set up an SFTP server on Amazon EC2. ££ Amazon EC2
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).

explanations.A: Use AWS DataSync 正确：AWS DataSync是一种专门设计用于高效传输文件数据的服务，支持跨区域传输，并且具有低操作开销。 DataSync可以自动化数据传输过程，支持NFS文件系统，非常适合本题场景。
explanations.B: Use AWS Snowball devices 错误：AWS Snowball设备通常用于一次性的大量数据迁移，而不是周期性的数据传输。 使用Snowball需要手动操作设备，操作开销较高，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.C: Set up an SFTP server on Amazon EC2 错误：设置SFTP服务器需要手动配置和管理EC2实例，增加了操作开销。 虽然可以实现数据传输，但不如DataSync高效目自动化。
explanations.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 错误：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而不是文件系统数据传输。 本题要求传输的是NFS文件系统数据，DMS不适用。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which AWS solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
options.B: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Assign an IAM role to the application to grant access to the S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the application server.

explanations.A: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. 错误原因：AWS DataSync是用于数据迁移的服务，而不是用于提供共享存储的解决方案。它不能直接提供SMB协议支持，也不符 合“完全托管”的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. 错误原因：虽然可以通过EC2实例配置Windows文件共享来支持SMB协议，但这不是“完全托管”的解决方案。用户需要自行管理EC2 实例的操作系统、文件共享配置和维护。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. 正确原因：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，专门支持SMB协议。它满足题目要求的“完全托 管”和“SMB客户端访问”的需求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. 错误原因：Amazon S3是对象存储服务，不支持SMB协议。虽然可以通过IAM角色授予访问权限，但它无法直接作为文件系统挂载 到应用程序服务器。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to run an in-memory database for a latency-sensitive application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes more than 100,000 transactions each minute and requires high network throughput. A solutions architect needs to provide a cost-effective network design that minimizes data transfer charges. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Launch all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with cluster strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.B: Launch all EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with partition strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.C: Deploy an Auto Scaling group to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones based on a network utilization target.
options.D: Deploy an Auto Scaling group with a step scaling policy to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones.

explanations.A: Launch all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with cluster strategy when launching EC2 instances. 正确：Cluster Placement Group策略将实例放置在同一可用区的低延迟网痬中，优化了网痬性能，适合高知吐量和低延迟的应用场 景。 正确：在同一可用区内的数据传输是免费的，符合成本优化的要求。
explanations.B: Launch all EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with partition strategy when launching EC2 instances. 错误：Partition Placement Group策略适用于分布式应用程序，主要用于輰畹故障域，而不是优化网痬性能。 错误：跨可用区的数据传输会产椹费用，不符合成本优化的要求。
explanations.C: Deploy an Auto Scaling group to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones based on a network utilization target. 错误：Auto Scaling Group主要用于动态扩展实例数量，而不是优化网痬性能。 错误：跨可用区的数据传输会产椹费用，不符合成本优化的要求。
explanations.D: Deploy an Auto Scaling group with a step scaling policy to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones. 错误：Step Scaling Policy主要用于根据负载动态调整实例数量，而不是优化网痬性能。 错误：跨可用区的数据传输会产椹费用，不符合成本优化的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company that primarily runs its application servers on premises has decided to migrate to AWS. The company wants to minimize its need to scale its Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) storage on premises. The company wants only its recently accessed data to remain stored locally. Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway
options.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes

explanations.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway主要用于将文件存储到Amazon S3，同时提供本地缓存以加速访问。它适用于文件级存储场景，而题目中 提到的是iSCSI存储（块级存储），因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway Tape Gateway主要用于将本地备份磁带虚拟化并存储到AWS云中，适用于备份和归档场景。题目中没有提到备份或归档需求，因此 此选项不符合要求。
explanations.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes Stored Volumes模式会将所有数据存储在本地，并定期备份到AWS云中。这种模式需要较大的本地存储容量，而题目要求“仅最邮访 问的数据存储在本地”，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes Cached Volumes模式会将所有数据存储在AWS云中，仅将最邮访问的数据缓存到本地。这种模式可以有效减少本地存储需求，同时 满足题目要求，因此此选项是正确答案。

question: Topic 1 A company has multiple AWS accounts that use consolidated billing. The company runs several active high performance Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances for 90 days. The company’s finance team has access to AWS Trusted Advisor in the consolidated billing account and all other AWS accounts. The finance team needs to use the appropriate AWS account to access the Trusted Advisor check recommendations for RDS. The finance team must review the appropriate Trusted Advisor check to reduce RDS costs. Which combination of steps should the finance team take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the account where the RDS instances are running.
options.B: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the consolidated billing account to see all RDS instance checks at the same time,
options.C: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.
options.D: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.
options.E: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization.

explanations.A: 使用运行RDS实例的账户中的Trusted Advisor建议。 错误：虽然可以在运行RDS实例的账户中查看Trusted Advisor建议，但合并计费账户可以集中查看所有子账户的资源建议，更加高 效。因此此选项不是最佳选择。
explanations.B: 使用合并计费账户中的Trusted Advisor建议，以同时查看所有RDS实例检查。 正确：合并计费账户可以集中查看所有子账户的资源使用嬦况和优化建议，适合跨账户成本优化场景。
explanations.C: 审查Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization的Trusted Advisor检查。 错误：虽然Reserved Instance Optimization是一个成本优化检查项，但题目中提到的是高性能On-Demand实例运行了90天，Idle DB Instances检查更符合场景需求。
explanations.D: 审查Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances的Trusted Advisor检查。 正确：Idle DB Instances检查可以宿助识别未充分利用的数据寑实例，从而优化成本。这是题目场景中需要的检查项之一。
explanations.E: 审查Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization的Trusted Advisor检查。 错误：题目中讨论的是Amazon RDS实例，而不是Amazon Redshift，因此此选项与题目无关。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to optimize storage costs. The solutions architect must identify any Amazon S3 buckets that are no longer being accessed or are rarely accessed. Which solution will accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard for advanced activity metrics.
options.B: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 dashboard in the AWS Management Console.
options.C: Turn on the Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes metric for buckets. Analyze bucket access patterns by using the metrics data with Amazon Athena.
options.D: Turn on AWS CloudTrail for S3 object monitoring. Analyze bucket access patterns by using CloudTrail logs that are integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.

explanations.A: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard for advanced activity metrics. 正确：S3 Storage Lens提供了高级活动指标，可以答案分析存储橘的访问模式，目操作开销最低。 它是专门设计用于监控和优化S3存储的工具，支持跨账户和跨区域的分析。
explanations.B: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 dashboard in the AWS Management Console. 错误：S3仪表板提供基本的存储人息，但不支持详细的访问模式分析。 它无法提供高级活动指标，因此无法满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Turn on the Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes metric for buckets. Analyze bucket access patterns by using the metrics data with Amazon Athena. 错误：BucketSizeBytes仅提供存储大小人息，而不是访问模式数据。 使用Amazon Athena分析数据增加了操作复杂性，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Turn on AWS CloudTrail for S3 object monitoring. Analyze bucket access patterns by using CloudTrail logs that are integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs. 错误：CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用日志，而不是直接分析存储橘访问模式。 使用CloudTrail和CloudWatch Logs进行分析需要额外的配置和操作，增加了操作开销。

question: Topic 1 A company sells datasets to customers who do research in artificial intelligence and machine learning (Al/ML). The datasets are large, formatted files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. The company hosts a web application that the customers use to purchase access to a given dataset. The web application is deployed on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. After a purchase is made, customers receive an S3 signed URL that allows access to the files. The customers are distributed across North America and Europe. The company wants to reduce the cost that is associated with data transfers and wants to maintain or improve performance. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the existing S3 bucket. Direct customer requests to the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the existing S3 bucket as the origin. Direct customer requests to the CloudFront URL. Switch to CloudFront signed URLs for access control.
options.C: Set up a second S3 bucket in the eu-central-1 Region with S3 Cross-Region Replication between the buckets. Direct customer requests to the closest Region. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.D: Modify the web application to enable streaming of the datasets to end users. Configure the web application to read the data from the existing S3 bucket. Implement access control directly in the application. IT

explanations.A: 配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration 正确性：S3 Transfer Acceleration可以加速跨区域的数据传输，但它主要优化的是上传速度，而不是下载速度。 问题：虽然可以继续使用S3签名URL，但Transfer Acceleration无法显著降低数据传输成本，也无法改善北美和欧洲用户的下载性 能。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 正确性：CloudFront是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以缓存S3中的数据并分发到边缘位置，从而显著降低数据传输成本并提 高性能。 优势：通过CloudFront签名URL可以实现更安全的访问控制，同时优化了北美和欧洲用户的访问速度。 结论：此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 设置第二个 S3 存储橘并启用跨区域复制 正确性：跨区域复制可以将数据复制到多个区域，从而优化性能。 问题：此方法会增加存储成本，并且需要额外的迂辑来管理用户请求的区域分配。相比CloudFront，这种方法的成本更高且复杂度 更高。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 修改 Web 应用程序以启用流式传输 正确性：流式传输可以减少一次性下载的带宽需求，但需要对应用程序进行重大修改。 问题：此方法无法显著降低数据传输成本，也无法优化北美和欧洲用户的性能。实现复杂度较高。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is using AWS to design a web application that will process insurance quotes. Users will request quotes from the application. Quotes must be separated by quote type, must be responded to within 24 hours, and must not get lost. The solution must maximize operational efficiency and must minimize maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type. Configure the web application to send messages to the proper data stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL) to pool messages from its own data stream.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for each quote type. Subscribe the Lambda function to its associated SNS topic. Configure the application to publish requests for quotes to the appropriate SNS topic.
options.C: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure SNS message filtering to publish messages to the proper SQS queue based on the quote type. Configure each backend application server to use its own SQS queue.
options.D: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams based on the quote type to deliver data streams to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Configure the application to send messages to the proper delivery stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to search for the messages from OpenSearch Service and process them accordingly.

explanations.A: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type... 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis适用于实时数据流处理，但题目要求消息不能丢失目需要高效维护。Kinesis需要额外的管理和开发工 作（如KCL），不符合“最大化操作效率和最小化维护”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 正确性分析：虽然SNS可以发送消息，但它本身不保证消息持久性（消息可能丢失）。Lambda函数的触发也不适合处理需要持久存 储的消息队列场景。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 正确性分析：此选项结合了SNS和SQS的优点。SNS负责消息分发，SQS负责消息持久化和处理。通过SNS消息过滤，可以根据报价 类型将消息路由到正确的SQS队列。桹个后端应用服务器使用自己的SQS队列，确保消息不会丢失并满足业务需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams... 正确性分析：Kinesis Data Firehose主要用于数据传输到存储或分析服务（如OpenSearch），而不是消息队列场景。此选项不符合 题目要求的消息持久性和高效维护。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that runs on several Amazon EC2 instances. Each EC2 instance has multiple Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) data volumes attached to it. The application’s EC2 instance configuration and data need to be backed up nightly. The application also needs to be recoverable in a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Region.
options.B: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EC2 instances as resources.
options.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application's EBS volumes as resources.
options.D: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Availability Zone.

explanations.A: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application’s EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Region. 分析： 使用AWS Lambda函数可以实现自动化备份，但需要手动编写代码来管理快照和跨区域复制，增加了开发和维护的复杂性。 虽然可以满足需求，但操作效率较低，不是最优解。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EC2 instances as resources. 分析： AWS Backup是一种托管服务，可以答案创建备份计划并自动执行备份任务。 将EC2实例作为资源添加到备份计划中，可以备份实例配置和数据，同时支持跨区域复制。 操作效率高，完全满足题目要求。 结论： 正确。
explanations.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EBS volumes as resources. 分析： 虽然可以备份EBS卷，但题目要求备份的是整个EC2实例的配置和数据，而不仅仅是EBS卷。 此选项未覆盖EC2实例的配置备份，因此不完全满足需求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Availability Zone. 分析： 此选项仅将快照复制到另一个可用区，而不是另一个区域，无法满足题目要求的跨区域恢复需求。 使用Lambda函数增加了开发和维护的复杂性，操作效率较低。 结论： 错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a mobile app on AWS. The company wants to expand its reach to millions of users. The company needs to build a platform so that authorized users can watch the company’s content on their mobile devices. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Publish content to a public Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stream content.
options.B: Set up IPsec VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.
options.D: Set up AWS Client VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.

explanations.A: Publish content to a public Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stream content. 错误原因：将内容发布到公共 S3 存储橘会暴轄内容，无法证保只有授权用户可以访问。虽然 AWS KMS 提供加密功能，但它并不直 接支持流媒体服务，也无法解决内容分发的性能问题。
explanations.B: Set up IPsec VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content. 错误原因：IPsec VPN 主要用于安全的网络连接，而不是内容分发。它不适合大规模用户访问的场景，目性能和成本都不适合流媒 体服务。
explanations.C: Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content. 正确原因：Amazon CloudFront 是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以高效地分发内容并支持流媒体服务。签名 URL 可以确保只 有授权用户能够访问内容，从而满足安全性要求。
explanations.D: Set up AWS Client VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content. 错误原因：AWS Client VPN 主要用于辧程用户安全访问 AWS 资源，而不是内容分发。它不适合流媒体服务的场景，目无法解决性 能问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises MySQL database used by the global sales team with infrequent access patterns. The sales team requires the database to have minimal downtime. A database administrator wants to migrate this database to AWS without selecting a particular instance type in anticipation of more users in the future. Which service should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Amazon Aurora MySQL
options.B: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL
options.C: Amazon Redshift Spectrum
options.D: Amazon RDS for MySQL

explanations.A: Amazon Aurora MySQL Amazon Aurora MySQL是一个高性能的关系数据库服务，兼容MySQL。 虽然Aurora MySQL提供了高可用性和性能，但它需要选择具体的实例类型，无法满足题目中“不选择特定实例类型”的要求。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.B: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL Amazon Aurora Serverless是一个按需自动扩展的数据库服务，支持MySQL，适合不频繁访问的场景。 它不需要选择具体的实例类型，能够根据负载自动调整容量，满足题目中“迁移数据库、支持未来扩展、最小停机时间”的要求。 因此，此选项正确。
explanations.C: Amazon Redshift Spectrum Amazon Redshift Spectrum是用于分析数据的服务，适合处理大规模数据集。 它不是关系型数据库服务，目不支持MySQL数据库迁移。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.D: Amazon RDS for MySQL Amazon RDS for MySQL是一个托管的关系数据库服务，兼容MySQL。 虽然它支持迁移，但需要选择具体的实例类型，无法满足题目中“不选择特定实例类型”的要求。 因此，此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company experienced a breach that affected several applications in its on-premises data center. The attacker took advantage of vulnerabilities in the custom applications that were running on the servers. The company is now migrating its applications to run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement a solution that actively scans for vulnerabilities on the EC2 instances and sends a report that details the findings. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Shield to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Create an AWS Lambda function to log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Macie and AWS Lambda functions to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.C: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty. Deploy the GuardDuty agents to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.
options.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector. Deploy the Amazon Inspector agent to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.

explanations.A: Deploy AWS Shield to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Create an AWS Lambda function to log any findings to AWS CloudTrail. 错误：AWS Shield主要用于保护应用免受DDoS攻击，而不是扫描EC2实例的漏洞。它不具备主动扫描和报告漏洞的功能。
explanations.B: Deploy Amazon Macie and AWS Lambda functions to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Log any findings to AWS CloudTrail. 错误：Amazon Macie主要用于识别和保护敏感数据（如PII），而不是扫描EC2实例的漏洞。它不适合用于漏洞扫描。
explanations.C: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty. Deploy the GuardDuty agents to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty是一个威胁检测服务，用于识别恶意活动和异常行为，但它不专注于漏洞扫描。GuardDuty不需要代理部 署到EC2实例上。
explanations.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector. Deploy the Amazon Inspector agent to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings. 正确：Amazon Inspector是专门设计用于扫描EC2实例的漏洞的服务。它可以主动检测安全问题并生成详痢的报告。 Amazon Inspector需要在EC2实例上安装代理以执行扫描任务。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run a script to poll for and process messages in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The company wants to reduce operational costs while maintaining its ability to process a growing number of messages that are added to the queue. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the size of the EC2 instance to process messages faster.
options.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when the instance is underutilized.
options.C: Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand.

explanations.A: 增加 EC2 实例的大小以更快地处理消息。 错误：增加 EC2 实例的大小虽然可以提高处理速度，但无法解决成本问题，目无法动态扩展以应对消息数量的增长。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 在实例未充分利用时关闭 EC2 实例。 错误：虽然可以减少未使用时的成本，但无法动态扩展以处理队列中不断增长的消息量。
explanations.C: 将 EC2 实例上的脚本迁移到具有适当运行时的 AWS Lambda 函数。 正确：AWS Lambda 是无服务器架构，按需运行，支持动态扩展，能够有效降低成本并处理增长的消息量。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 按需运行脚本。 错误：虽然可以按需运行脚本，但无法动态扩展以处理队列中不断增长的消息量。

question: Topic 1 A company uses a legacy application to produce data in CSV format. The legacy application stores the output data in Amazon S3. The company is deploying a new commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) application that can perform complex SQL queries to analyze data that is stored in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 only. However, the COTS application cannot process the .csv files that the legacy application produces. The company cannot update the legacy application to produce data in another format. The company needs to implement a solution so that the COTS application can use the data that the legacy application produces. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs on a schedule. Configure the ETL job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Develop a Python script that runs on Amazon EC2 instances to convert the .csv files to .sql files. Invoke the Python script on a cron schedule to store the output files in Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use an S3 event to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to launch an Amazon EMR cluster on a weekly schedule. Configure the EMR cluster to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in an Amazon Redshift table. IT

explanations.A: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs on a schedule. Configure the ETL job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in Amazon Redshift. 分析： AWS Glue是专门设计用于ETL任务的服务，支持直接处理CSV文件。 可以通过调度自动运行，减少人工干轘，操作开销低。 Amazon Redshift是目标存储，符合题目要求。 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Develop a Python script that runs on Amazon EC2 instances to convert the .csv files to .sql files. Invoke the Python script on a cron schedule to store the output files in Amazon S3. 分析： 需要手动开发和维护Python脚本，增加了开发和运维开销。 EC2实例需要持痲运行，成本较高。 输出文件存储在Amazon S3，但题目要求数据存储在Amazon Redshift。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use an S3 event to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in the DynamoDB table. 分析： AWS Lambda可以处理ETL任务，但DynamoDB不是题目要求的目标存储。 题目明确要求数据存储在Amazon Redshift或Amazon S3，而非DynamoDB。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to launch an Amazon EMR cluster on a weekly schedule. Configure the EMR cluster to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in an Amazon Redshift table. 分析： Amazon EMR适合处理大规模数据，但对于简单的CSV文件处理任务，使用EMR会增加不必要的复杂性和成本。 EventBridge可以调度任务，但整体操作开销较高。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company recently migrated its entire IT environment to the AWS Cloud. The company discovers that users are provisioning oversized Amazon EC2 instances and modifying security group rules without using the appropriate change control process. A solutions architect must devise a strategy to track and audit these inventory and configuration changes. Which actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing.
options.B: Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard.
options.D: Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes.
options.E: Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template.

explanations.A: Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing. 正确。AWS CloudTrail是一个日志记录服务，可以跟踪用户活动和API调用，适用于审计和变更跟踪。 它能够记录用户对AWS资源的操作，帮助公司了解谁在做什么。
explanations.B: Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances. 错误。数据生命周期策略主要用于管理存储（如S3对象生命周期），与审计和配置跟踪无关。 它不能解决用户社度配置EC2实例或修改安全组规则的问题。
explanations.C: Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard. 错误。AWS Trusted Advisor提供优化建议，包括安全性、成本和性能，但它不是专门用于审计和配置跟踪的工具。 虽然安全仪表板可以提供一些安全建议，但它无法直接跟踪资源配置的变更。
explanations.D: Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes. 正确。AWS Config是一个配置管理服务，可以跟踪资源配置的历史记录，并创建规则以确保合规性。 它能够帮助公司畁控资源配置的变更，并确保遵守既定的变更控制流程。
explanations.E: Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template. 错误。虽然AWS CloudFormation可以用于资源配置管理，但它主要用于部署和恢复资源，而不是实时跟踪和审计配置变更。 此选项无法解决用户随意修改安全组规则的问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has hundreds of Amazon EC2 Linux-based instances in the AWS Cloud. Systems administrators have used shared SSH keys to manage the instances. After a recent audit, the company’s security team is mandating the removal of all shared keys. A solutions architect must design a solution that provides secure access to the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of administrative overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to generate one-time SSH keys on demand.
options.C: Allow shared SSH access to a set of bastion instances. Configure all other instances to allow only SSH access from the bastion instances.
options.D: Use an Amazon Cognito custom authorizer to authenticate users. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate a temporary SSH key.

explanations.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances. 正确：AWS Systems Manager Session Manager是一种无代理的方式，可以安全地连接到EC2实例，无需使用SSH密钥或开放端口。 它提供了最少的管理开销，因为不需要维护密钥或配置额外的网痬设置。
explanations.B: Use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to generate one-time SSH keys on demand. 错误：AWS STS主要用于生成临时认证以访问AWS资源，而不是专门设计用于生成一次性SSH密钥。 此选项需要额外的开发工作来实现生成和分发SSH密钥，增加了管理开销。
explanations.C: Allow shared SSH access to a set of bastion instances. Configure all other instances to allow only SSH access from the bastion instances. 错误：虽然使用堡垒主机是一种常见的安全访问方法，但它仍然依赖共享SSH密钥，违反了题目要求。 此外，维护堡垒主机和管理访问权限会增加管理开销。
explanations.D: Use an Amazon Cognito custom authorizer to authenticate users. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate a temporary SSH key. 错误：此选项涉及复杂的自定义开发工作，包括设置Cognito、Lambda函数和SSH密钥生成逻辑。 这种方法的管理开销较高，不符合“最少管理开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is using a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances to ingest data from on-premises data sources. The data is in JSON format and ingestion rates can be as high as 1 MB/s. When an EC2 instance is rebooted, the data in-flight is lost. The company’s data science team wants to query ingested data in near-real time. Which solution provides near-real-time data querying that is scalable with minimal data loss?

options.A: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Kinesis Data Analytics to query the data.
options.B: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon Redshift as the destination. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data.
options.C: Store ingested data in an EC2 instance store. Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon S3 as the destination. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Store ingested data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Publish data to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Subscribe to the Redis channel to query the data.

explanations.A: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Use Kinesis Data Analytics to query the data. 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams是专门设计用于实时数据流处理的服务，能够处理高知吐量的数据流。 正确：Kinesis Data Analytics可以直接查询流数据，支持辢实时的数据分析。 正确：Kinesis Data Streams提供数据持久性，避免数据丢失，即使EC2实例重启也不会影响数据流。
explanations.B: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon Redshift as the destination. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data. 错误：Kinesis Data Firehose是用于数据流的批量传输服务，不能提供辢实时查询能力。 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，适合批量查询而非实时查询。
explanations.C: Store ingested data in an EC2 instance store. Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon S3 as the destination. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. 错误：EC2实例存储是临时存储，数据会在实例重启时丢失，不适合持久化数据。 错误：Kinesis Data Firehose和Amazon S3的组合适合批量数据存储，但不支持辢实时查询。 错误：Amazon Athena是基于S3的查询服务，适合批量查询而非实时查询。
explanations.D: Store ingested data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Publish data to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Subscribe to the Redis channel to query the data. 错误：EBS卷是块存储服务，适合持久化数据，但不适合实时数据流处理。 错误：ElastiCache for Redis适合缓存数据，但不支持复杂的实时查询功能。

question: Topic 1 What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all objects uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket are encrypted?

options.A: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set.
options.B: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set to private.
options.C: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an aws:SecureTransport header set to true.
options.D: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an x-amz-server-side-encryption header set.

explanations.A: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set. 错误：s3:x-amz-acl标头用于设置对象的访问控制列表（ACL），与加密无关。
explanations.B: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set to private. Correct Answer: D 正确答案：D Community vote distribution 社区投票分布 D (100%) IT正确答案社 区投: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 票分: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 布人: Examtopics 错误：虽然设置ACL为private可以限制访问，但它与确保对象加密无关。
explanations.C: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an aws:SecureTransport header set to true. 错误：aws:SecureTransport标头用于确保通过HTTPS传输数据，与对象加密无关。
explanations.D: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an x-amz-server-side-encryption header set. 正确：x-amz-server-side-encryption标头用于指定对象上传时的服务器端加密方式，符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a multi-tier application for a company. The application's users upload images from a mobile device. The application generates a thumbnail of each image and returns a message to the user to confirm that the image was uploaded successfully. The thumbnail generation can take up to 60 seconds, but the company wants to provide a faster response time to its users to notify them that the original image was received. The solutions architect must design the application to asynchronously dispatch requests to the different application tiers. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received.
options.D: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete.

explanations.A: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function. 分析： Lambda函数可以处理缩略图生成，但它是同步触发的，无法实现异步处理。 用户需要快速确正上传成功，而Lambda函数的执行时间可能较长（最多60秒），无法满足快速响应的需求。 此选项未提到如何异步处理请求，因此不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete. 分析： AWS Step Functions适合复杂的工作流编排，但题目要求的是异步处理，而不是复杂的工作流管理。 Step Functions的设计更适合需要多个步骤的任务，而本题的需求较简单，使用Step Functions可能过于复杂。 此选项未提到如何快速响应用户上传成功的消息，因此不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received. 分析： Amazon SQS是一个完全托管的消息队列服务，适合异步处理任务。 将上传的图像人息放入SQS队列后，可以立即向用户发送确正消息，满足快速响应的需求。 异步处理缩略图生成任务，符合题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete. 分析： Amazon SNS适合发布/订阅模式，但题目要求的是异步处理，而不是通知机制。 此选项未提到如何快速响应用户上传成功的消息，因此不符合题目要求。 使用SNS进行缩略图生成的逻辑不够清晰，目不符合题目需求的异步处理架构设计。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company's facility has badge readers at every entrance throughout the building. When badges are scanned, the readers send a message over HTTPS to indicate who attempted to access that particular entrance. A solutions architect must design a system to process these messages from the sensors. The solution must be highly available, and the results must be made available for the company’s security team to analyze. Which system architecture should the solutions architect recommend?

explanations.A: 启动一个Amazon EC2实例作为HTTPS端点并处理消息。配置EC2实例将结果保存到Amazon S3存储橘中。 错误：EC2实例需要手动管理，可能会成为单点故障，无法满足高可用性要求。 错误：虽然S3可以存储数据，但EC2实例的处理能力有限，目不符合无服务器架构的最佳实践。
explanations.B: 在Amazon API Gateway中创建一个HTTPS端点。配置API Gateway端点以调用一个AWS Lambda函数来处理消息，并将结果 保存到Amazon DynamoDB表中。 正确：API Gateway提供高可用的HTTPS端点，Lambda函数是无服务器的，自动扩展，适合处理消息。 正确：DynamoDB是高可用的数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据供后续分析。 正确：此架构完全符合高可用性和无服务器架构的要求。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon Route 53将传感器消息定向到一个AWS Lambda函数。配置Lambda函数处理消息并将结果保存到Amazon DynamoDB表中。 错误：Route 53是DNS服务，不适合直接处理HTTPS请求。 错误：Route 53无法充当HTTPS端点，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: 为Amazon S3创建一个网关VPC端点。配置一个站点到站点VPN连接，从设施网络连接到VPC，以便通过VPC端点将传感器数据 直接写入S3存储橘。 错误：此选项没有提到如何处理消息，仅仅是将数据写入S3，不符合题目要求。 错误：VPN连接增加了复杂性，目不符合无服务器架构的最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to implement a disaster recovery plan for its primary on-premises file storage volume. The file storage volume is mounted from an Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) device on a local storage server. The file storage volume holds hundreds of terabytes (TB) of data. The company wants to ensure that end users retain immediate access to all file types from the on-premises systems without experiencing latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the company's existing infrastructure?

options.A: Provision an Amazon S3 File Gateway as a virtual machine (VM) that is hosted on premises. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Modify existing applications to access the files through the NFS protocol. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and mount the S3 bucket that contains the files.
options.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Use a data backup solution to back up all existing data to a virtual tape library. Configure the data backup solution to run nightly after the initial backup is complete. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and restore the data to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume from the volumes in the virtual tape library.
options.C: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Mount the Volume Gateway cached volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.D: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume with the same amount of disk space as the existing file storage volume. Mount the Volume Gateway stored volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.

explanations.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway 正确性分析：S3 File Gateway适用于文件存储场景，支持通过NFS或SMB协议访问文件。但本题要求使用iSCSI协议，而S3 File Gateway不支持iSCSI协议。 错误原因：需要修改现有应用程序以通过NFS协议访问文件，这会对现有基础设施造成较大变更，不符合题目要求的“最少变更”。
explanations.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway 正确性分析：Tape Gateway主要用于备份和归档场景，数据存储在虚拟磁带库中。恢复时需要将数据从磁带库恢复到EBS卷。 错误原因：Tape Gateway不适合实时文件访问场景，用户无法直接访问文件，目恢复过程可能会导致较高的延迟，不符合题目要求 的“立即访问”。
explanations.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume 正确性分析：Volume Gateway cached volume将数据主要存储在AWS云端，只有部分数据保留在本地缓存中。通过iSCSI协议访问 数据，符合现有基础设施的要求。 错误原因：由于数据主要存储在云端，用户访问文件时可能会受到网络延迟的影响，不符合题目要求的“无延迟访问”。
explanations.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume 正确性分析：Volume Gateway stored volume将所有数据存储在本地，同时定期将快照备份到AWS云端。通过iSCSI协议访问数据， 完全符合现有基础设施的要求。 正确原因：用户可以立即访问所有文件，无需修改现有应用程序，目灾难恢复过程简单高效，符合题目要求的“最少变更”和“无延迟 访问”。

question: Topic 1 A company is hosting a web application from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon Cognito as an identity provider to authenticate users and return a JSON Web Token (JWT) that provides access to protected resources that are stored in another S3 bucket. Upon deployment of the application, users report errors and are unable to access the protected content. A solutions architect must resolve this issue by providing proper permissions so that users can access the protected content. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content.
options.B: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content.
options.C: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content.
options.D: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content.

explanations.A: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content. 正确：Amazon Cognito身份池可以配置IAM角色，允许用户通过身份池获得访问受保护资源的权限。 解决问题：通过更新身份池的配置，确保用户能够获得正确的IAM角色权限，从而访问受保护的S3内容。
explanations.B: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content. 错误：S3 ACL主要用于设置对象级别的权限，但题目中提到的是用户通过Amazon Cognito进行身份验证并访问资源，而不是直接通 社应用程序访问资源。 不解决问题：ACL无法解决用户无法通过身份池获得权限的问题。
explanations.C: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content. 错误：S3的最终一致性读取与用户权限问题无关。题目中提到的问题是用户无法访问受保护资源，而不是数据读取一致性问题。 不解决问题：重新部署应用程序无法解决权限配置问题。
explanations.D: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content. 错误：题目中并未提到需要使用自定义属性映射。解决问题的关键是更新身份池的IAM角色配置，而不是自定义属性映射。 不解决问题：自定义属性映射与用户权限问题无关。

question: Topic 1 An image hosting company uploads its large assets to Amazon S3 Standard buckets. The company uses multipart upload in parallel by using S3 APIs and overwrites if the same object is uploaded again. For the first 30 days after upload, the objects will be accessed frequently. The objects will be used less frequently after 30 days, but the access patterns for each object will be inconsistent. The company must optimize its S3 storage costs while maintaining high availability and resiliency of stored assets. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days.
options.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads.
options.C: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers.
options.D: Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 30
options.E: Move assets to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.

explanations.A: Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days. 正确：S3 Intelligent-Tiering是一种自动优化存储成本的存储类别，适合访问模式不一致的场景。它会根据访问频率自动将对象移动 到适当的存储层，无需手动干预。 推荐使用S3 Intelligent-Tiering，因为题目提到对象的访问模式在30天后变得不一致。
explanations.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads. 正确：不完整的分橘上传会占用存储疑间，配置椹命周期策略清理这些上传可以优化存储成本。 这是一个最佳实践，尤其是对于使用并行分橘上传的场景。
explanations.C: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers. 错误：题目没有提到标本控制或删除标记相关的场景，因此这个选项与题目要求无关。
explanations.D: Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 错误：虽然S3 Standard-IA适合访问频率较低的对象，但它不适合访问模式不一致的场景。题目明确提到访问模式不一致，因此S3 Intelligent-Tiering更合适。
explanations.E: Move assets to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA的可用性和数据持久性较低，不适合需要高可用性和高持久性的场景。题目明确要求高可用性和高持久性。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect must secure a VPC network that hosts Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances contain highly sensitive data and run in a private subnet. According to company policy, the EC2 instances that run in the VPC can access only approved third- party software repositories on the internet for software product updates that use the third party’s URL. Other internet traffic must be blocked. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups.
options.B: Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets.
options.C: Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs.
options.D: Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances. Direct all outbound traffic to the ALB. Use a URL- based rule listener in the ALB's target group for outbound access to the internet.

explanations.A: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups. 正确：AWS Network Firewall支持基于域名的规则组，可以有效地限制出站流量到指定的第三方软件寑。 正确：通过更新路由表，将流量引导到AWS Network Firewall，可以实现集中管理和过滤。 符合题目要求：仅允许访问指定的第三方软件寑，其他流量被阻桬。
explanations.B: Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets. 错误：AWS WAF主要用于保护Web应用程序免受嬡嬯流量攻击，而不是用于管理VPC的出站流量。 错误：AWS WAF无法直接基于域名或URL过滤出站流量。
explanations.C: Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs. 错误：安全组不支持基于URL的规则，只能基于IP地址或端口号进行流量控制。 错误：无法满足题目要求的基于域名的流量过滤。
explanations.D: Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances. Direct all outbound traffic to the ALB. Use a URL-based rule listener in the ALB’s target group for outbound access to the internet. 错误：ALB主要用于处理入站流量，而不是出站流量。 错误：ALB的规则监听器无法直接基于URL过滤出站流量。

question: Topic 1 A company is hosting a three-tier ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The company hosts the website on Amazon S3 and integrates the website with an API that handles sales requests. The company hosts the API on three Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The API consists of static and dynamic front-end content along with backend workers that process sales requests asynchronously. The company is expecting a significant and sudden increase in the number of sales requests during events for the launch of new products. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure that all the requests are processed successfully?

options.A: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Increase the number of EC2 instances to handle the increase in traffic.
options.B: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Place the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on network traffic.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Add an Amazon ElastiCache instance in front of the ALB to reduce traffic for the API to handle.
options.D: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive requests from the website for later processing by the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Increase the number of EC2 instances to handle the increase in traffic. 错误：CloudFront主要用于优化静嬒内容的分发，而动嬒内容的分发通常需要其他优化方式。 错误：仅增加EC2实例数量可能无法解决寢桯处理的需求，无法保证所有请求都被成功处理。
explanations.B: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Place the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on network traffic. 部分正确：CloudFront用于优化静嬒内容的分发是合理的。 错误：Auto Scaling虽然可以动嬒扩展EC2实例，但无法解决寢桯处理的需求，可能导致请求丢失。
explanations.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Add an Amazon ElastiCache instance in front of the ALB to reduce traffic for the API to handle. 错误：CloudFront不适合动嬒内容的分发，目ElastiCache主要用于缓存数据，而不是处理寢桯请求。 错误：ElastiCache无法解决请求的寢桯处理问题。
explanations.D: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive requests from the website for later processing by the EC2 instances. 正确：CloudFront优化静嬒内容的分发可以减少网站的负载。 正确：SQS队列可以接收请求并进行寢桯处理，确保所有请求都被成功处理。

question: Topic 1 A security audit reveals that Amazon EC2 instances are not being patched regularly. A solutions architect needs to provide a solution that will run regular security scans across a large fleet of EC2 instances. The solution should also patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule and provide a report of each instance’s patch status. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up Amazon Macie to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up a cron job on each EC2 instance to patch the instance on a regular schedule.
options.B: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty in the account. Configure GuardDuty to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.C: Set up Amazon Detective to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.

explanations.A: Set up Amazon Macie to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up a cron job on each EC2 instance to patch the instance on a regular schedule. 错误：Amazon Macie主要用于数据分类和敏感数据保护，不适用于扫描EC2实例的软件漏洞。 错误：使用cron job手动管理补丁更新不符合自动化和集中管理的要求。
explanations.B: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty in the account. Configure GuardDuty to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty主要用于检测恶意活动和异常行为，不适用于扫描软件漏洞。 错误：AWS Systems Manager Session Manager用于远程访问EC2实例，而不是用于补丁管理。
explanations.C: Set up Amazon Detective to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule. 错误：Amazon Detective主要用于调查和分析安全事件，不适用于扫描软件漏洞。 错误：虽然Amazon EventBridge可以触发定时任务，但它不是专门用于补丁管理的工具。
explanations.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector in the account. Configure Amazon Inspector to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule. 正确：Amazon Inspector专门用于扫描EC2实例的软件漏洞。 正确：AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager可以自动化补丁管理并定期更新EC2实例。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to store data on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must encrypt the data at rest. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable encryption for the DB instances.
options.B: Create an encryption key. Store the key in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the key to encrypt the DB instances.
options.C: Generate a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.
options.D: Generate a certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.

explanations.A: Create a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable encryption for the DB instances. 正确：AWS KMS是用于管理加密密迫的服务，RDS支持通过KMS密迫来启用数据静态加密。 在创建RDS实例时，可以选择使用KMS密迫来加密数据。
explanations.B: Create an encryption key. Store the key in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the key to encrypt the DB instances. 错误：AWS Secrets Manager主要用于存储和管理敏感人息（如密畡、API密迫），而不是直接用于加密RDS实例。 RDS实例的加密需要通过KMS密迫，而不是Secrets Manager中的密迫。
explanations.C: Generate a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate. 错误：ACM用于管理SSL/TLS证书，这些证书主要用于传输层加密（encryption in transit），而不是数据静态加密。 本题要求的是数据静态加密，而不是传输层加密。
explanations.D: Generate a certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate. 错误：IAM不用于生成SSL/TLS证书，SSL/TLS证书通常由ACM管理。 此外，本题要求的是数据静态加密，而不是传输层加密。

question: Topic 1 A company must migrate 20 TB of data from a data center to the AWS Cloud within 30 days. The company’s network bandwidth is limited to 15 Mbps and cannot exceed 70% utilization. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Snowball.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync.
options.C: Use a secure VPN connection.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.

explanations.A: Use AWS Snowball 正确。AWS Snowball是一种物理设备，用于大规模数据迁移。它适合在网络带宽有限的情况下进行数据传输，因为数据通过设备而 不是网络传输。 在本题中，网络带宽限制为15 Mbps目不能超过70%利用率，使用AWS Snowball可以避免网络瓶轛并满足30天内迁移20 TB数据的 要求。
explanations.B: Use AWS DataSync 错误。AWS DataSync适用于通过网络进行数据迁移，但受限于网络带宽。在本题中，15 Mbps的带宽限制无法高效传输20 TB数 据，目可能超过70%利用率。
explanations.C: Use a secure VPN connection 错误。VPN连接适合小规模数据传输或实时数据同步，但不适合大规模数据迁移。受限于网络带宽，使用VPN无法在30天内完成20 TB数据迁移。
explanations.D: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 错误。Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration通过优化网络路径加速数据上传，但仍依赖网络带宽。在本题中，网络带宽限制无法支持高 效传输20 TB数据。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to provide its employees with secure access to confidential and sensitive files. The company wants to ensure that the files can be accessed only by authorized users. The files must be downloaded securely to the employees’ devices. The files are stored in an on-premises Windows file server. However, due to an increase in remote usage, the file server is running out of capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the file server to an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet. Configure the security group to limit inbound traffic to the employees’ IP addresses.
options.B: Migrate the files to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Integrate the Amazon FSx file system with the on- premises Active Directory. Configure AWS Client VPN.
options.C: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a private VPC endpoint. Create a signed URL to allow download.
options.D: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a public VPC endpoint. Allow employees to sign on with AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).

explanations.A: Migrate the file server to an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet. Configure the security group to limit inbound traffic to the employees’ IP addresses. 错误原因：将文件服务器迁移到公共子网中的 EC2 实例并限制 IP 地址虽然可以提供访问，但公共子网的安全性较低，目没有提到 如何解决文件下载的安全性问题。 此外，这种方法没有扩展性，目没有提到如何与现有的 Active Directory 集成。
explanations.B: Migrate the files to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Integrate the Amazon FSx file system with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure AWS Client VPN. 正确原因：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是专门为 Windows 文件存储设计的解决方案，支持与本地 Active Directory 集成。 通过 AWS Client VPN，可以为员工提供安全的远程访问，确保文件下载的安全性。 此选项满足题目中关于安全访问和与现有架构集成的要求。
explanations.C: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a private VPC endpoint. Create a signed URL to allow download. 错误原因：虽然 Amazon S3 可以存储文件并通过签名 URL 提供安全下载，但此选项没有提到如何与现有的 Active Directory 集成。 此外，S3 的使用场景更适合对象存储，而不是传统的文件存储。
explanations.D: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a public VPC endpoint. Allow employees to sign on with AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). 错误原因：创建公共 VPC 端点会暴需文件存储，降低安全性。 虽然 AWS IAM Identity Center 提供身份验证，但此选项没有提到如何确保文件下载的安全性，也没有与现有架构集成。

question: Topic 1 A company’s application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. On the first day of every month at midnight, the application becomes much slower when the month-end financial calculation batch runs. This causes the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances to immediately peak to 100%, which disrupts the application. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure the application is able to handle the workload and avoid downtime?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB.
options.B: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization.
options.C: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.
options.D: Configure Amazon ElastiCache to remove some of the workload from the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB. 错误：CloudFront主要用于内容分发和缓存静态资源，无法直接解决EC2实例CPU利用率高的问题。 虽然可以减少部分流量压力，但无法解决计算密集型任务导致的性能问题。
explanations.B: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization. 错误：简单扩展策略基于实时CPU使用率触发扩展，但无法提前应对已知的周期性高负载场景。 在负载通到峰值后才开始扩展，可能导致短时间内的性能问题。
explanations.C: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule. 正确：定时扩展策略可以根据已知的周期性负载提前扩展资源，确保应用程序在高负载时能够正常运行。 这是解决周期性高负载问题的最佳实践。
