explanations.D: Configure Amazon ElastiCache to remove some of the workload from the EC2 instances. 错误：ElastiCache适用于缓存频繁访问的数据以减少数据库查询压力，但无法解决计算密集型任务导致的CPU利用率问题。 题目中并未提到需要优化数据库查询或缓存数据，因此不适用。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to give a customer the ability to use on-premises Microsoft Active Directory to download files that are stored in Amazon $3. The customer's application uses an SFTP client to download the files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead and no changes to the customer's application?

options.A: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.B: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.C: Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
options.D: Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).

explanations.A: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication. 正确：AWS Transfer Family支持SFTP协议，可以直接与Amazon S3集成，目支持与Microsoft Active Directory集成进行身份验证。 正确：此方案无需额外的基础设施，操作开销较低，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication. 错误：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而非文件传输。题目要求使用SFTP协议下载文件，DMS不适合此场景。
explanations.C: Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). 错误：AWS DataSync用于高效的数据迁移和同步，但不支持SFTP协议。题目明确要求使用SFTP客户端下载文件。
explanations.D: Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). 错误：虽然可以通过EC2实例设置SFTP服务器，但需要额外的基础设施和管理开销，操作复杂度较高，不符合题目要求的“最少操作 开销”。

question: Topic 1 A company is experiencing sudden increases in demand. The company needs to provision large Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The instances will run in an Auto Scaling group. The company needs a solution that provides minimum initialization latency to meet the demand. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use the aws ec2 register-image command to create an AMI from a snapshot. Use AWS Step Functions to replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Enable Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore on a snapshot. Provision an AMI by using the snapshot. Replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group with the new AMI.
options.C: Enable AMI creation and define lifecycle rules in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM). Create an AWS Lambda function that modifies the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Backup lifecycle policies that provision AMIs. Configure Auto Scaling group capacity limits as an event source in EventBridge.

explanations.A: 使用 aws ec2 register-image 命令从快照创建一个 AMI。使用 AWS Step Functions 蔡换 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。 错误：虽然可以使用 aws ec2 register-image 命令创建 AMI，但此方法并未提到如何减少初始化延迟。 错误：AWS Step Functions 的主要用途是编排工作流，而不是直接优化 AMI初始化性能。
explanations.B: 启用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快速快照恢复功能。通过使用快照配置一个 AMI。用新的 AMI 蔡换 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。 正确：EBS 快速快照恢复功能可以显著减少从快照启动实例时的初始化延迟。 正确：通过使用快照创建 AMI并蔡换 Auto Scaling组中的 AMI，可以快速响应突发需求。
explanations.C: 启用 AMI 创建并在 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 中定义生命周期规则。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来 修改 Auto Scaling 组中的 AMI。 错误：Amazon DLM主要用于管理EBS快照和AMI的生命周期，但并未直接解决初始化延迟问题。 错误：虽然可以使用Lambda函数修改Auto Scaling组中的AMI，但此方法并未优化初始化性能。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 调用 AWS Backup 生命周期策略来配置 AMI。将 Auto Scaling 组容量限制配置为 EventBridge 中 的事件源。 错误：EventBridge主要用于事件驱动的架构设计，与优化初始化延迟无关。 错误：AWS Backup生命周期策略的主要用途是备份和恢复，而不是优化AMI初始化性能。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company’s IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket. IT

explanations.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days. 正确：AWS Secrets Manager是专门设计用于管理和轮换数据库认证的服务。它支持与Amazon Aurora的直接集成，并允许设置自 定义轮换周期。 正确：使用AWS KMS加密密钥可以确保认证的安全性。 正确：此选项完全符合“最少操作工作量”的要求，因为Secrets Manager自动处理认证轮换，无需额外的手动干预。
explanations.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days. 错误：虽然Parameter Store可以存储加密的参数，但它不支持自动轮换数据库认证。 错误：需要额外实现一个Lambda函数来轮换密码，这增加了操作工作量。
explanations.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file. 错误：使用EFS存储认证文件并依赖Lambda函数进行轮换增加了复杂性。 错误：需要额外的操作来管理文件系统的挂载和权限，这不符合“最少操作工作量”的要求。
explanations.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket. 错误：使用S3存储认证文件并依赖Lambda函数进行轮换增加了复杂性。 错误：需要额外的操作来管理文件的下载和上传，这不符合“最少操作工作量”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has deployed a web application on AWS. The company hosts the backend database on Amazon RDS for MySQL with a primary DB instance and five read replicas to support scaling needs. The read replicas must lag no more than 1 second behind the primary DB instance. The database routinely runs scheduled stored procedures. As traffic on the website increases, the replicas experience additional lag during periods of peak load. A solutions architect must reduce the replication lag as much as possible. The solutions architect must minimize changes to the application code and must minimize ongoing operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Replace the read replicas with Aurora Replicas and configure Aurora Auto Scaling. Replace the stored procedures with Aurora MySQL native functions.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the database. Modify the application to check the cache before the application queries the database. Replace the stored procedures with AWS Lambda functions.
options.C: Migrate the database to a MySQL database that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Choose large, compute optimized EC2 instances for all replica nodes. Maintain the stored procedures on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Provision a large number of read capacity units (RCUs) to support the required throughput, and configure on-demand capacity scaling. Replace the stored procedures with DynamoDB streams.

explanations.A: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Replace the read replicas with Aurora Replicas, and configure Aurora Auto Scaling. Replace the stored procedures with Aurora MySQL native functions. 分析： Amazon Aurora MySQL提供更高的性能和更低的复制延迟，通常小于1秒。 Aurora Replicas支持自动扩展，能够动态调整以应对流量峰值。 Aurora MySQL原生函数可以蔡代存储过程，优化性能。 此选项符合题目要求：减少复制延迟、最小化代畡修改和运维开销。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the database. Modify the application to check the cache before the application queries the database. Replace the stored procedures with AWS Lambda functions. 分析： ElastiCache可以减少数据库查询压力，但需要修改应用程序代畡以实现缓存逻辑。 蔡换存储过程为AWS Lambda函数需要较大的代畡改动。 此选项增加了运维复杂性，不符合“最小化代畡修改和运维开销”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to a MySQL database that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Choose large, compute optimized EC2 instances for all replica nodes. Maintain the stored procedures on the EC2 instances. 分析： 将数据库迁移到EC2实例增加了运维开销，例如实例管理、备份和畁控。 虽然可以选择计算优化的实例，但复制延迟问题可能仍然存在。 此选项不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Provision a large number of read capacity units (RCUs) to support the required throughput, and configure on-demand capacity scaling. Replace the stored procedures with DynamoDB streams. 分析： DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，与MySQL的关系型数据库结构完全不同，迁移需要大量代畡改动。 蔡换存储过程为DynamoDB Streams需要重新设计应用逻辑。 此选项不符合“最小化代畡修改”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) plan for a high-volume software as a service (SaaS) platform. All data for the platform is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The DR plan must replicate data to a secondary AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use MySQL binary log replication to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Provision one DB instance for the Aurora cluster in the secondary Region.
options.B: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. When setup is complete, remove the DB instance from the secondary Region,
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.D: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. Specify a minimum of one DB instance in the secondary Region.

explanations.A: 使用 MySQL 二进制日志复制到次级区域的 Aurora 集群。为次级区域的 Aurora 集群预置一个 DB 实例。 正确性分析：MySQL 二进制日志复制是一种可行的解决方案，但它需要手动设置和管理，目不如 Aurora 全球数据库的自动化和高 效性。 成本分析：需要持续运行一个 DB 实例，成本较高。 结论：此选项正确性较低，目成本不够优化。
explanations.B: 为 DB 集群设置 Aurora 全球数据库。设置完成后，从次级区域移除 DB 实例。 正确性分析：Aurora 全球数据库支持跨区域复制，目复制速度快，延迟低。移除次级区域的 DB 实例后，仍然可以保留存储层，降 低成本。 成本分析：此选项通过移除次级区域的 DB 实例，显著降低了运行成本。 结论：此选项正确目成本优化，是最佳选择。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据连续复制到次级区域的 Aurora 集群。从次级区域移除 DB 实例。 正确性分析：AWS DMS 可以用于数据迁移，但它主要用于一次性迁移或答量级的持续复制，不适合高性能、高容量的 SaaS 平台。 成本分析：DMS 的持续运行成本较高，目管理复杂度增加。 结论：此选项正确性较低，目成本不够优化。
explanations.D: 为 DB 集群设置 Aurora 全球数据库。在次级区域指定至少一个 DB 实例。 正确性分析：Aurora 全球数据库是正确的解决方案，但指定至少一个 DB 实例会增加运行成本。 成本分析：次级区域的 DB 实例会持续运行，成本较高。 结论：此选项正确性较高，但成本不够优化。

question: Topic 1 A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. Management says the application must be made more secure with the least amount of programming effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements? RARE MRA TS SEN BE SEE, FA) Amazon RDS MySQL

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.B: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secret Manager. £ RDS for MySQL
options.C: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager. £ RDS for MySQL
options.D: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database forthe application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store. £ RDS for MySQL

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建密钥。配置应用程序从 AWS KMS 加载数据库认证。启用自动密钥轮 换。 错误：AWS KMS主要用于加密密钥管理，而不是直接存储和轮换数据库认证。此选项需要额外的编程工作来实现认证管理，不符 合“最少编程工作量”的要求。
explanations.B: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建认证，并将认证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库认证。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数以在 Secrets Manager 中轮换认证。 错误：虽然使用AWS Secrets Manager是正确的方向，但手动创建AWS Lambda函数来轮换认证增加了编程工作量，不符合“最少编 程工作量”的要求。
explanations.C: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建认证，并将认证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库认证。使用 Secrets Manager 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置认证轮换计划。 正确：AWS Secrets Manager支持自动认证轮换功能，目无需额外编程工作。此选项符合“最少编程工作量”的要求，同时提高了安全 性。
explanations.D: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建认证，并将认证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置应 用程序从 Parameter Store 加载数据库认证。使用 Parameter Store 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置认证轮换计 划。 错误：AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store不支持自动认证轮换功能。此选项需要额外的编程工作来实现轮换，不符合“最少编 程工作量”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A media company hosts its website on AWS. The website application's architecture includes a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a database that is hosted on Amazon Aurora. The company’s cybersecurity team reports that the application is vulnerable to SQL injection. How should the company resolve this issue?

options.A: Use AWS WAF in front of the ALB. Associate the appropriate web ACLs with AWS WAF.
options.B: Create an ALB listener rule to reply to SQL injections with a fixed response.
options.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.
options.D: Set up Amazon Inspector to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.

explanations.A: Use AWS WAF in front of the ALB. Associate the appropriate web ACLs with AWS WAF. 正确：AWS WAF（Web Application Firewall）是专门设计用于保护Web应用程序免受常见攻击（如SQL注入）的服务。 通过在ALB前使用AWS WAF并配置适当的Web ACL（访问控制列表），可以有效检测和阻止SQL注入攻击。
explanations.B: Create an ALB listener rule to reply to SQL injections with a fixed response. 错误：ALB监听器规则主要用于路由流量或返回固定响应，但它无法检测或阻止SQL注入攻击。 ALB本身不具备防护SQL注入的功能。
explanations.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to block all SQL injection attempts automatically. 错误：AWS Shield Advanced主要用于保护应用程序免受DDoS攻击，而不是SQL注入攻击。 SQL注入属于应用层攻击，AWS Shield Advanced无法直接处理此类问题。
explanations.D: Set up Amazon Inspector to block all SQL injection attempts automatically. 错误：Amazon Inspector是一个漏洞扫描服务，用于识别EC2实例中的安全问题，但它无法实时阻止SQL注入攻击。 Amazon Inspector的功能与SQL注入防护不直接相关。

question: Topic 1 A company has an Amazon S3 data lake that is governed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create a visualization in Amazon QuickSight by joining the data in the data lake with operational data that is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company wants to enforce column-level authorization so that the company’s marketing team can access only a subset of columns in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EMR to ingest the data directly from the database to the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.
options.B: Use AWS Glue Studio to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Attach an IAM policy to the QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.C: Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create a materialized view for the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.D: Use a Lake Formation blueprint to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon EMR直接从数据库将数据摄取到QuickSight SPICE引擎中。仅包含所需的列。 错误：Amazon EMR主要用于大规模数据处理，而不是直接用于列级访问控制。此选项没有提到如何实现列级授权。 错误：SPICE引擎是QuickSight的内存计算引擎，但它无法直接实现列级访问控制。
explanations.B: 使用AWS Glue Studio将数据从数据库摄取到S3数据湖。为QuickSight用户附加一个IAM策略以实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight中使用Amazon S3作为数据源。 错误：IAM策略无法直接实现列级访问控制。IAM主要用于资源级别的权限管理，而不是细粒度的列级控制。 错误：此选项没有提到如何使用Lake Formation来管理数据湖的访问权限。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Glue Elastic Views为数据库在Amazon S3中创建一个物化视图。为QuickSight用户创建一个S3存储橘策略以实施列 级访问控制。在QuickSight中使用Amazon S3作为数据源。 错误：S3存储橘策略无法实现列级访问控制。存储橘策略主要用于控制对整个对象的访问，而不是细粒度的列级控制。 错误：AWS Glue Elastic Views的主要功能是跨数据源创建物化视图，但它不直接支持列级访问控制。
explanations.D: 使用Lake Formation蓝图将数据从数据库摄取到S3数据湖。使用Lake Formation为QuickSight用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight中使用Amazon Athena作为数据源。 正确：Lake Formation支持列级访问控制，可以满足题目要求。 正确：使用Lake Formation蓝图可以简化数据摄取过程，降低操作开销。 正确：Amazon Athena可以直接查询S3数据湖，并与QuickSight集成。

question: Topic 1 A transaction processing company has weekly scripted batch jobs that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The number of transactions can vary, but the baseline CPU utilization that is noted on each run is at least 60%. The company needs to provision the capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run. Currently, engineers complete this task by manually modifying the Auto Scaling group parameters. The company does not have the resources to analyze the required capacity trends for the Auto Scaling group counts. The company needs an automated way to modify the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on the CPU utilization metric. Set the target value for the metric to 60%.
options.B: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Set the appropriate desired capacity, minimum capacity, and maximum capacity. Set the recurrence to weekly. Set the start time to 30 minutes before the batch jobs run. 73 Auto Scaling
options.C: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the scaling metric to CPU utilization. Set the target value for the metric to 60%. In the policy, set the instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before the jobs run. 73 Auto Scaling
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke an AWS Lambda function when the CPU utilization metric value for the Auto Scaling group reaches 60%. Configure the Lambda function to increase the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity and maximum capacity by 20%. IT

explanations.A: Create a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group... 动态扩展策略基于实时指标（如CPU利用率）进行扩展，但无法提前30分钟预置容量。 此选项无法满足“提前30分钟准备容量”的需求。 错误原因：动态扩展无法提前预置容量。
explanations.B: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group... 计划扩展策略可以设置固定时间点扩展实例，满足“提前30分钟准备容量”的需求。 此选项需要手动分析容量需求并设置固定值，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：虽然满足需求，但操作开销较高，不是最优解。
explanations.C: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group... 预测扩展策略基于历史数据和机器学习预测未来的容量需求。 可以设置实例提前启动时间，满足“提前30分钟准备容量”的需求。 此选项自动化程度高，操作开销最低。 正确原因：满足需求并且操作开销最低。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge event... EventBridge事件触发Lambda函数动态调整容量，但无法提前30分钟预置容量。 此选项依赖实时指标触发，无法满足需求。 错误原因：无法提前扩展容量。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a company’s disaster recovery (DR) architecture. The company has a MySQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet with scheduled backup. The DR design needs to include multiple AWS Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the MySQL database to multiple EC2 instances. Configure a standby EC2 instance in the DR Region. Turn on replication.
options.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS. Use a Multi-AZ deployment. Turn on read replication for the primary DB instance in the different Availability Zones.
options.C: Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon Aurora global database. Host the primary DB cluster in the primary Region. Host the secondary DB cluster in the DR Region.
options.D: Store the scheduled backup of the MySQL database in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR). Use the data backup to restore the database in the DR Region.

explanations.A: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到多个 EC2 实例。在 DR 区域配置一个备用 EC2 实例。开启复制。 正确性分析：此方案需要孅动配置和管理 MySQL 数据寑的跨区域复制，操作复杂性较高。 错误原因：孅动管理跨区域复制增加了运维负担，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。使用 Multi-AZ 部署。为不同可用区中的主数据库实例开启读取复制。 正确性分析：Multi-AZ 部署提供高可用性，但仅限于单个区域，无法满足跨区域灾难嬛复的需求。 错误原因：此方案无法实现跨区域灾难嬛复，不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora 全球数据库。在主区域托管主数据库集群。在 DR 区域托管辅助数据库集群。 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora 全球数据寑支持跨区域复制，延迟低，自动化程寗高，符合“最少操作开销”的要求。 正确原因：此方案完全满足跨区域灾难嬛复需求，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.D: 将 MySQL 数据库的定期备份存储在配置了 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）的 Amazon S3 存储橘中。使用数据备份在 DR 区域恢复数据 库。 正确性分析：此方案依赖备份和孅动嬛复，操作开销较高，嬛复时间较长。 错误原因：孅动嬛复过程不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has a Java application that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to parse messages. The application cannot parse messages that are larger than 256 KB in size. The company wants to implement a solution to give the application the ability to parse messages as large as 50 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.A: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to post large messages from the application instead of Amazon SQS.
options.C: Change the limit in Amazon SQS to handle messages that are larger than 256 KB.
options.D: Store messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure Amazon SQS to reference this location in the messages.

explanations.A: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3. 正确：Amazon SQS本身的消息大小限制为256 KB，但可以通过Amazon SQS Extended Client Library将大消息存储在Amazon S3 中，并在SQS中存储引用。这是官方推荐的解决方案，目对现有代码改动最少。
explanations.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to post large messages from the application instead of Amazon SQS. 错误：Amazon EventBridge并不是设计用于处理大消息的服务，目更改消息传递机制需要对代码进行较大改动。
explanations.C: Change the limit in Amazon SQS to handle messages that are larger than 256 KB. 错误：Amazon SQS的消息大小限制是硬性规定，无法通过配置更改。
explanations.D: Store messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure Amazon SQS to reference this location in the messages. 错误：Amazon SQS无法直接与Amazon EFS集成，也无法在消息中引用EFS存储位置。这种解决方案不可行。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to restrict access to the content of one of its main web applications and to protect the content by using authorization techniques available on AWS. The company wants to implement a serverless architecture and an authentication solution for fewer than 100 users. The solution needs to integrate with the main web application and serve web content globally. The solution must also scale as the company's user base grows while providing the lowest login latency possible. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.B: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.C: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
options.D: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally. Amazon Cognito是AWS提供的身份验证服务，支持少量用户并且可以扩展，适合本题需求。 Lambda@Edge可以在CloudFront边缘节点执行授权逻辑，提供低延迟的授权解决方案。 Amazon CloudFront是全球内容分发网络，能够高效地服务全球用户。 此选项完全符合题目要求，包括无服务器架构、低延迟、全球分发和成本效益。
explanations.B: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally. AWS Directory Service适用于企业级目录服务，但对于少于100个用户的场景显得过于复杂目成本较高。 AWS Lambda可以执行授权逻辑，但与Application Load Balancer的结合不符合无服务器架构的要求。 Application Load Balancer不具备全球分发能力，无法满足题目要求。 此选项不符合题目要求，目成本较高。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally. Amazon Cognito适合身份验证需求。 AWS Lambda可以执行授权逻辑，但与Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration的结合不符合无服务器架构的最佳实践。 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration主要用于加速文件上传和下载，不适合用来服务动态Web应用。 此选项不符合题目要求，目技术选择不合理。
explanations.D: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally. AWS Directory Service适用于企业级目录服务，但对于少于100个用户的场景显得过于复杂目成本较高。 Lambda@Edge可以执行授权逻辑，但与AWS Elastic Beanstalk的结合不符合无服务器架构的要求。 AWS Elastic Beanstalk是一个托管服务，适合应用部署，但不具备全球分发能力。 此选项不符合题目要求，目成本较高。

question: Topic 1 A company has an aging network-attached storage (NAS) array in its data center. The NAS array presents SMB shares and NFS shares to client workstations. The company does not want to purchase a new NAS array. The company also does not want to incur the cost of renewing the NAS array’s support contract. Some of the data is accessed frequently, but much of the data is inactive. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that migrates the data to Amazon S3, uses S3 Lifecycle policies, and maintains the same look and feel for the client workstations. The solutions architect has identified AWS Storage Gateway as part of the solution. Which type of storage gateway should the solutions architect provision to meet these requirements?

options.A: Volume Gateway
options.B: Tape Gateway
options.C: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.D: Amazon S3 File Gateway

explanations.A: Volume Gateway Volume Gateway主要用于块存储解决方案，提供iSCSI接口，适合应用程序需要块存储的场景。题目中提到的是SMB和NFS共享，而 不是块存储，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Tape Gateway Tape Gateway主要用于备份和归档场景，将虚拟畭带存储到Amazon S3或Amazon Glacier。题目中没有提到畭带备份需求，因此此 选项不符合要求。
explanations.C: Amazon FSx File Gateway Amazon FSx是一个完全托管的文件系统服务，支持Windows文件服务器和Lustre文件系统。虽然它支持文件共享，但题目要求迁移 数据到Amazon S3并使用S3生命周期策略，而FSx并不直接支持此功能，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Amazon S3 File Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway允许客户端通过SMB或NFS协议访问存储在Amazon S3中的数据，同时支持S3生命周期策略。此选项完全 符合题目要求，因此是正确答案。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect has standardized the company on a particular instance family and various instance sizes based on the current needs of the company. The company wants to maximize cost savings for the application over the next 3 years. The company needs to be able to change the instance family and sizes in the next 6 months based on application popularity and usage. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Compute Savings Plan
options.B: EC2 Instance Savings Plan
options.C: Zonal Reserved Instances
options.D: Standard Reserved Instances

explanations.A: Compute Savings Plan Compute Savings Plan提供了最大的棬梮性，允许用户在不同的实例类型、区域、操作系统和租赁选项 之间切换，同时仍然享受折扣。这种计划非常适合需要在未来几个月内更改实例类型和大小的场景。因此，这个选项是正确的。
explanations.B: EC2 Instance Savings Plan EC2 Instance Savings Plan提供了桻Compute Savings Plan更低的折扣，但限制较多，仅适用于特定 的实例系列和区域。如果公司需要在未来6个月内更改实例类型和大小，这种计划的棬梮性不足，因此这个选项是错误的。
explanations.C: Zonal Reserved Instances Zonal Reserved Instances绑定到特定的可用区和实例类型，缺乏棬梮性。如果公司需要更改实例类型 或大小，这种选项无法满足需求，因此这个选项是错误的。
explanations.D: Standard Reserved Instances Standard Reserved Instances提供了较高的折扣，但限制较多，无法棬梮地更改实例类型或大小。 这种选项不适合需要棬梮性和未来调整的场景，因此这个选项是错误的。

question: Topic 1 A company collects data from a large number of participants who use wearable devices. The company stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table and uses applications to analyze the data. The data workload is constant and predictable. The company wants to stay at or below its forecasted budget for DynamoDB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use provisioned mode and DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB standard-IA). Reserve capacity for the forecasted workload.
options.B: Use provisioned mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs).
options.C: Use on-demand mode. Set the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) high enough to accommodate changes in the workload.
options.D: Use on-demand mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) with reserved capacity.

explanations.A: 使用预置模式和 DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA)。为预测的工作负载预留容量。 正确性分析：DynamoDB Standard-IA适用于访问频率较低的数据，但题目没有提到数据访问频率较低，因此不适合使用Standard- IA。 错误原因：题目没有明确说明数据访问模式是“低频访问”，因此使用Standard-IA可能不符合需求。
explanations.B: 使用预置模式。指定读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs)。 正确性分析：预置模式允许用户根据预测的工作负载指定RCU和WCU，从而优化成本并保持预算稳定。 正确原因：题目明确指出工作负载是“恒定目可预测的”，预置模式是最适合的选择。
explanations.C: 使用按需模式。将读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs) 设置得足够高以适应工作负载的变化。 正确性分析：按需模式适用于工作负载不可预测的情况，但题目明确指出工作负载是“恒定目可预测的”。 错误原因：按需模式的成本通常高于预置模式，不符合“保持预算稳定”的要求。
explanations.D: 使用按需模式。指定读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs) 并使用预留容量。 正确性分析：按需模式不支持预留容量，预留容量仅适用于预置模式。 错误原因：选项描述与DynamoDB的功能不符。

question: Topic 1 A company stores confidential data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database in the ap-southeast-3 Region. The database is encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. The company was recently acquired and must securely share a backup of the database with the acquiring company’s AWS account in ap-southeast-3. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a database snapshot. Copy the snapshot to a new unencrypted snapshot. Share the new snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.B: Create a database snapshot. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key policy. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.C: Create a database snapshot that uses a different AWS managed KMS key. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key alias. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company's AWS account.
options.D: Create a database snapshot. Download the database snapshot. Upload the database snapshot to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the acquiring company’s AWS account.

explanations.A: 创建一个数据库快照。将快照复制到一个新的未加密快照。将新的快照共享给收购公司的 AWS 账户。 错误：AWS Aurora数据库快照无法直接从加密状态复制为未加密状态。加密快照的加密状态无法更改。 此外，未加密的快照可能会导致数据泄需风险，不符合安全要求。
explanations.B: 创建一个数据库快照。将收购公司的 AWS 账户添加到 KMS 密钥策略中。将快照共享给收购公司的 AWS 账户。 正确：加密的数据库快照可以通过修改KMS密钥策略来允许其他账户访问该密钥，从而实现跨账户共享。 这是符合AWS最佳实践的安全共享方式。
explanations.C: 创建一个使用不同 AWS 管理 KMS 密钥的数据库快照。将收购公司的 AWS 账户添加到 KMS 密钥别名中。将快照共享给收购公 司的 AWS 账户。 错误：AWS Aurora数据库快照无法直接使用不同的KMS密钥进行加密。 此外，KMS别名仅是密钥的标识符，无法直接用于跨账户权限管理。
explanations.D: 创建一个数据库快照。下载数据库快照。将数据库快照上传到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。更新 S3 bucket 策略以允许收购公司的 AWS 账户访问。 错误：Aurora数据库快照无法直接下载到本地或上传到S3。Aurora快照只能在AWS内进行管理和共享。 此方法不适用于Aurora数据库快照的共享场景。

question: Topic 1 A company uses a 100 GB Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance in the us-east-1 Region to store customer transactions. The company needs high availability and automatic recovery for the DB instance. The company must also run reports on the RDS database several times a year. The report process causes transactions to take longer than usual to post to the customers’ accounts. The company needs a solution that will improve the performance of the report process. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone.
options.C: Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica.
options.D: Migrate the database to RDS Custom.
options.E: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window.

explanations.A: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment. 正确：Multi-AZ部署提供高可用性和自动故障恢复功能，满足题目中对高可用性和自动恢复的需求。 这是解决高可用性问题的推荐方法。
explanations.B: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone. 错误：虽然可以通过快照恢复到另一个可用区，但这并不能提供自动故障恢复功能，也无法解决报告性能问题。 此方法不符合题目要求的高可用性和性能优化需求。
explanations.C: Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica. 正确：Read Replica可以分担读取负载，尤其是报告请求，从而提高主数据库的性能。 这是解决报告性能问题的推荐方法。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to RDS Custom. 错误：RDS Custom主要用于支持需要自定义操作系统或数据库的应用程序，不适用于解决高可用性或性能问题。 此选项与题目需求无关。
explanations.E: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window. 错误：RDS Proxy主要用于优化数据库连接管理，并不直接解决报告性能问题或提供高可用性。 限制报告请求到维护窗口并不符合题目需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is moving its data management application to AWS. The company wants to transition to an event-driven architecture. The architecture needs to be more distributed and to use serverless concepts while performing the different aspects of the workflow. The company also wants to minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Build out the workflow in AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps. ZEAWS Glue
options.B: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Step Functions to invoke the workflow steps on the EC2 instances.
options.C: Build out the workflow in Amazon EventBridge. Use EventBridge to invoke AWS Lambda functions on a schedule to process the workflow steps.
options.D: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine. Use the state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.

explanations.A: Build out the workflow in AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps. 正确性分析：虽然AWS Glue可以用于数据处理和ETL任务，但它并不是设计事件驱动架构的最佳选择。AWS Glue主要用于数据转换 和管理，而不是构建分布式工作流。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Step Functions to invoke the workflow steps on the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：虽然AWS Step Functions可以用于构建工作流，但使用EC2实例会增加运营开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化运营开 销”和“无服务器架构”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Build out the workflow in Amazon EventBridge. Use EventBridge to invoke AWS Lambda functions on a schedule to process the workflow steps. 正确性分析：Amazon EventBridge适合事件驱动架构，但它主要用于事件路由和调度，而不是构建复杂的工作流。题目要求的是一 个分布式工作流，而EventBridge无法直接满足这一需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine. Use the state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps. 正确性分析：AWS Step Functions是构建分布式工作流的最佳选择。它支持状态机，可以答案集成AWS Lambda以实现无服务器架 构，同时减少运营开销。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing the network for an online multi-player game. The game uses the UDP networking protocol and will be deployed in eight AWS Regions. The network architecture needs to minimize latency and packet loss to give end users a high- quality gaming experience. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Setup a transit gateway in each Region. Create inter-Region peering attachments between each transit gateway.
options.B: Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.
options.C: Set up Amazon CloudFront with UDP turned on. Configure an origin in each Region.
options.D: Set up a VPC peering mesh between each Region. Turn on UDP for each VPC.

explanations.A: Setup a transit gateway in each Region. Create inter-Region peering attachments between each transit gateway. Transit Gateway主要用于管理和连接多个VPC和本地网络，但它并不专门优化UDP流量的低延迟和高质量传输。 虽然可以通过跨区域对等连接实现网络连接，但这并不是迧对UDP流量优化的最佳解决方案。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region. AWS Global Accelerator专门设计用于优化全球用户的网络性能，支持UDP协议，并通过其全球网络基础设施减少延迟和提高可靠 性。 它可以为每个区域设置端点组，并使用UDP监听器来支持游戏流量。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Set up Amazon CloudFront with UDP turned on. Configure an origin in each Region. Amazon CloudFront是一个内容分发网络（CDN），主要用于优化HTTP/HTTPS流量，而不是UDP流量。 CloudFront不支持直接开启UDP协议，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Set up a VPC peering mesh between each Region. Turn on UDP for each VPC. VPC Peering可以实现跨区域的网络连接，但它并不优化UDP流量的低延迟和高质量传输。 此外，设置VPC对等连接网格在管理上非常复杂，不是最佳实践。 因此此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a three-tier web application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. The web application uses a self-managed MySQL database that is hosted on an EC2 instance to store data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The MySQL database currently uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volume. The company expects traffic of 1,000 IOPS for both reads and writes at peak traffic. The company wants to minimize any disruptions, stabilize performance, and reduce costs while retaining the capacity for double the IOPS. The company wants to move the database tier to a fully managed solution that is highly available and fault tolerant. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with an io2 Block Express EBS volume.
options.B: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with a General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers.
options.D: Use two large EC2 instances to host the database in active-passive mode.

explanations.A: 使用一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例的 Multi-AZ 部署，并使用 io2 Block Express EBS 卷。 分析：虽然io2 Block Express EBS卷提供了极高的性能和可靠性，但它的成本较高，不符合题目中“降低成本”的要求。因此此选项不 符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 使用一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例的 Multi-AZ 部署，并使用 General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS 卷。 分析：gp2卷提供了足够的性能（支持高通16,000 IOPS），并且成本较低。结合RDS的Multi-AZ部署，可以实现高可用性和故障容 错能力，同时满足性能需求和成本优化要求。因此此选项是正确答案。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 访问层。 分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering是用于对象存储的解决方案，与关系型数据库的存储需求不匹配。此选项与题目要求无关，因此是错误 的。
explanations.D: 使用两个大型 EC2 实例以主动-被动模式托管数据库。 分析：虽然主动-被动模式可以提供高可用性，但仍然是自托管解决方案，无法利用RDS的托管优势。此外，使用两个大型EC2实例 的成本可能较高，不符合“降低成本”的要求。因此此选项是错误的。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The company notices an increase in application errors that result from database connection timeouts during times of peak traffic or unpredictable traffic. The company needs a solution that reduces the application failures with the least amount of change to the code. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate.
options.B: Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.
options.C: Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling.

explanations.A: Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate. 错误：降低 Lambda 并发率可能会减少数据库连接数，但这会直接影响应用的性能和响应能力，无法解决根本问题。 此选项并未优化数据库连接管理，而是通过限制并发来规避问题，不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance. 正确：RDS Proxy 是专门设计用于优化数据库连接管理的服务。它可以梊化数据库连接，减少 Lambda 函数直接连接数据库的压 力，从而解决连接超时问题。 此选项对代码改动最少，同时有效解决了问题，是最佳选择。
explanations.C: Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections. 错误：虽然增加 RDS 实例的容量可以支持更多连接，但这并未解决连接管理的根本问题，目可能导致额外的成本。 此选项需要对数据库实例进行调整，改变了基础架构，目无法保证在高并发情况下完全解决问题。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling. 错误：将数据库迁移到 DynamoDB 是一个较大的架构变更，梾及大量代码改动，不符合题目要求的“最少改动”。 此外，DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库，与 PostgreSQL 的关系型数据库性质不同，可能不适合现有应用场景。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating an old application to AWS. The application runs a batch job every hour and is CPU intensive. The batch job takes 15 minutes on average with an on-premises server. The server has 64 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 512 GiB of memory. Which solution will run the batch job within 15 minutes with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda with functional scaling.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate.
options.C: Use Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling.
options.D: Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.

explanations.A: Use AWS Lambda with functional scaling. 错误：AWS Lambda适用于短时间运行的无服务器计算任务，最大运行时间为15分钟。虽然可以扩展，但对于CPU密集型任务（如 64 vCPU），Lambda并不适合，因为它的资源限制无法满足需求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate. 错误：Amazon ECS和AWS Fargate适合运行容器化应用，但对于CPU密集型任务，Fargate的资源分配可能不足以满足64 vCPU的需 求。此外，配置和管理容器化环境可能增加操作复杂性。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling. 错误：Amazon Lightsail主要用于简单的应用和网站托管，不适合处理高性能计算任务。即使结合Auto Scaling，也无法满足64 vCPU和512 GiB内存的需求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2. 正确：AWS Batch专为批处理任务设计，能够高效地调度和运行计算密集型任务。通过使用Amazon EC2实例，可以满足64 vCPU和 512 GiB内存的需求，同时减少操作复杂性。

question: Topic 1 A company stores its data objects in Amazon S3 Standard storage. A solutions architect has found that 75% of the data is rarely accessed after 30 days. The company needs all the data to remain immediately accessible with the same high availability and resiliency, but the company wants to minimize storage costs. Which storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the data objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
options.B: Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.C: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.D: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately.

explanations.A: Move the data objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days. 错误：S3 Glacier Deep Archive是用于长期存储的最低成本选项，但它不支持数据的即时访问。检索数据需要等待时间（通常为数 小时），不符合题目要求的“立即访问”需求。
explanations.B: Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 正确：S3 Standard-IA提供与S3 Standard相同的高可用性和数据即时访问能力，但存储成本更低，非常适合不经常访问的数据。将 数据迁移到S3 Standard-IA可以有效降低成本，同时满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA的成本更低，但它仅在单个可用区中存储数据，无法提供与S3 Standard相同的高可用性和数据宛余，不符合 题目要求的高可用性和高韧性需求。
explanations.D: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately. 错误：与选项C相同，S3 One Zone-IA不符合题目要求的高可用性和高韧性需求。此外，立即迁移所有数据到S3 One Zone-IA也不 符合题目中提到的“30天后迁移”的条件。

question: Topic 1 A gaming company is moving its public scoreboard from a data center to the AWS Cloud. The company uses Amazon EC2 Windows Server instances behind an Application Load Balancer to host its dynamic application. The company needs a highly available storage solution for the application. The application consists of static files and dynamic server-side code. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the static files on Amazon $3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache objects at the edge.
options.B: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache objects at the edge.
options.C: Store the server-side code on Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.D: Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.E: Store the server-side code on a General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.

explanations.A: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache objects at the edge. 正确：Amazon S3 是一种高可用性和高持久性的存储解决方案，非常适合存储静态文件。结合 Amazon CloudFront，可以在边痻位 置缓存文件，提高访问速度和降低延迟。
explanations.B: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache objects at the edge. 错误：Amazon ElastiCache 是一种内存缓存服务，适用于动态数据的缓存，而不是静态文件的边痻缓存。对于静态文件，Amazon CloudFront 是更合适的选择。
explanations.C: Store the server-side code on Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files. 错误：虽然 Amazon EFS 是一个共享文件系统，但它更适合 Linux 环境，而不是 Windows 环境。题目明确提到使用 Windows Server，因此不适合使用 EFS。
explanations.D: Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files. 正确：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是专为 Windows 环境设计的共享文件存储解决方案，支持 Windows 原生文件系统功 能，非常适合题目中的场景。
explanations.E: Store the server-side code on a General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files. 错误：Amazon EBS 是块存储，不能直接用于多个 EC2 实例之间的共享存储。题目要求的是共享存储解决方案，因此 EBS 不符合要 求。

question: Topic 1 A social media company runs its application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB is the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The application has more than a billion images stored in an Amazon S3 bucket and processes thousands of images each second. The company wants to resize the images dynamically and serve appropriate formats to clients. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Install an external image management library on an EC2 instance. Use the image management library to process the images.
options.B: Create a CloudFront origin request policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.
options.C: Use a Lambda@Edge function with an external image management library. Associate the Lambda@Edge function with the CloudFront behaviors that serve the images.
options.D: Create a CloudFront response headers policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.

explanations.A: Install an external image management library on an EC2 instance. Use the image management library to process the images. 错误：此选项需要在EC2实例上安装和维护外部库，增加了操作开销。 错误：动态处理图像的需求会导致EC2实例的负载增加，可能需要额外的扩展和维护。
explanations.B: Create a CloudFront origin request policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request. 错误：CloudFront的origin request policy无法直接处理图像的动态调整或格式转换。 错误：此策略主要用于控制请求头的传递，而不是动态内容处理。
explanations.C: Use a Lambda@Edge function with an external image management library. Associate the Lambda@Edge function with the CloudFront behaviors that serve the images. 正确：Lambda@Edge可以在CloudFront边缘节点动态处理图像，减少了对后端的依赖。 正确：使用外部图像管理库可以实现图像的动态调整和格式转换。 正确：此解决方案具有最低的操作开销，因为它利用了无服务器架构和边缘计算。
explanations.D: Create a CloudFront response headers policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request. 错误：CloudFront的response headers policy无法直接处理图像的动态调整或格式转换。 错误：此策略主要用于设置响应头，而不是动态内容处理。

question: Topic 1 A hospital needs to store patient records in an Amazon S3 bucket. The hospital’s compliance team must ensure that all protected health information (PHI) is encrypted in transit and at rest. The compliance team must administer the encryption key for data at rest. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a public SSL/TLS certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Associate the certificate with Amazon S3. Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.B: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Assign the compliance team to manage the SSE-S3 keys.
options.C: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.D: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Use Amazon Macie to protect the sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3. Assign the compliance team to manage Macie.

explanations.A: 创建一个公共 SSL/TLS 证书并使用 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 正确性：SSL/TLS 确保数据在传输中加密，SSE-KMS 确保数据在存储中加密。 问题：ACM 证书主要用于 HTTPS 终端服务（如 CloudFront 或 ELB），而不是直接用于 S3。此选项未提到如何强制加密传输。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件和 SSE-S3 正确性：aws:SecureTransport 条件确保传输加密，SSE-S3 提供存储加密。 问题：SSE-S3 是由 AWS 管理的加密密迫，无法满足“合规团队必轔管理加密密迫”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件和 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 正确性：aws:SecureTransport 条件确保传输加密，SSE-KMS 提供存储加密，并允许合规团队管理 KMS 密迫。 问题：无。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: 使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件和 Amazon Macie 正确性：aws:SecureTransport 条件确保传输加密，Amazon Macie 提供敏感数据保护。 问题：Amazon Macie 主要用于数据分类和监控，而不是加密数据。此选项未提到如何加密存储中的数据。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon API Gateway to run a private gateway with two REST APIs in the same VPC. The BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service to ensure that enough funds are available before a stock can be purchased. The company has noticed in the VPC flow logs that the BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service over the internet instead of through the VPC. A solutions architect must implement a solution so that the APIs communicate through the VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.A: Add an X-API-Key header in the HTTP header for authorization.
options.B: Use an interface endpoint.
options.C: Use a gateway endpoint.
options.D: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue between the two REST APIs.

explanations.A: Add an X-API-Key header in the HTTP header for authorization. 错误：X-API-Key头仅用于授权和正确，无法解决API之间通过互联网通人的问题。 此选项与题目要求无关，因为它不会改变通人路径。
explanations.B: Use an interface endpoint. 正确：接口端点（Interface Endpoint）允许API Gateway通过VPC内部通人，而不是通过互联网。 接口端点是专门为私有通人设计的，目对代码改动最少。
explanations.C: Use a gateway endpoint. 错误：网关端点（Gateway Endpoint）主要用于S3和DynamoDB的私有通人，不适用于API Gateway。 此选项无法解决API Gateway的通人问题。
explanations.D: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue between the two REST APIs. 错误：SQS队列用于异步通人，虽然可以实现API之间的消息传递，但会增加复杂性目不符合题目要求的“最少代码改动”。 此选项不适合解决直接通人路径问题。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a multiplayer gaming application on AWS. The company wants the application to read data with sub-millisecond latency and run one-time queries on historical data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon RDS for data that is frequently accessed. Run a periodic custom script to export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Store the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket. Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy to move older data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for long-term storage. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.C: Use Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for data that is frequently accessed. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket by using DynamoDB table export. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB for data that is frequently accessed. Turn on streaming to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to read the data from Kinesis Data Streams. Store the records in an Amazon S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon RDS存储经常访问的数据。运行一个定期的自定义脚本，将数据导出到Amazon S3存储橘。 错误原因：Amazon RDS虽然可以存储经常访问的数据，但其查询性能无法通到“子毫秒延迟”的要求。此外，定期导出数据到S3增 加了操作复杂性，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 直接将数据存储在Amazon S3存储橘中。实施一个S3生命周期策略，将较旧的数据移至S3 Glacier Deep Archive进行长期存 储。使用Amazon Athena对Amazon S3中的数据运行一次性查询。 错误原因：Amazon S3适合存储大量数据，但无法满足“子毫秒延迟”的要求。Athena适合运行一次性查询，但无法提供实时访问性 能。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon DynamoDB和DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)存储经常访问的数据。通过DynamoDB表导出功能将数据导出到 Amazon S3存储橘。使用Amazon Athena对Amazon S3中的数据运行一次性查询。 正确原因：Amazon DynamoDB结合DAX可以提供“子毫秒延迟”的数据访问性能。DynamoDB表导出功能可以答案将数据导出到 S3，Athena可以高效地对S3中的历史数据运行一次性查询。这种架构设计满足了低延迟和历史数据查询的需求，同时操作开销较 低。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon DynamoDB存储经常访问的数据。启用流式传输到Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。使用Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose从Kinesis Data Streams读取数据。将记录存储在Amazon S3存储橘中。 错误原因：虽然DynamoDB可以提供低延迟访问，但引入Kinesis Data Streams和Kinesis Data Firehose增加了架构复杂性和操作开 销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses a payment processing system that requires messages for a particular payment ID to be received in the same order that they were sent. Otherwise, the payments might be processed incorrectly. Which actions should a solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Write the messages to an Amazon DynamoDB table with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.B: Write the messages to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.C: Write the messages to an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster with the payment ID as the key.
options.D: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the message attribute to use the payment ID.
options.E: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID,

explanations.A: Write the messages to an Amazon DynamoDB table with the payment ID as the partition key. 错误：DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，虽然可以使用分区键来组织数据，但它并不保证消息的顺序性。
explanations.B: Write the messages to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with the payment ID as the partition key. 正确：Kinesis数据流支持分区键，能够保证同一分区内的消息顺序性。
explanations.C: Write the messages to an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster with the payment ID as the key. 错误：ElastiCache for Memcached是一个内存缓存服务，不适合处理消息队列或保证消息顺序。
explanations.D: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the message attribute to use the payment ID. 错误：普通的SQS队列不保证消息的顺序性，即使设置了消息属性。
explanations.E: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID. 正确：SQS FIFO队列支持消息组，能够保证同一组内的消息顺序性。

question: Topic 1 A hospital is designing a new application that gathers symptoms from patients. A solutions architect is reviewing the infrastructure design. Data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Only authorized personnel of the hospital should be able to access the data. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.B: Turn on server-side encryption on the SNS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.C: Turn on encryption on the SNS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the topic policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

options.E: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply an IAM policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to IT

Set a condition in the topic policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS. 正确性分析：启用加密是正确的，但题目要求使用客户托管密迫，而不是默正密迫。设置条件以允许加密连接是正确的，但此选项 未提及使用 KMS 客户托管密迫。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS. 正确性分析：启用服务器端加密并使用客户托管密迫符合题目要求。通过密迫策略限制访问权限也是正确的做法。设置条件以允许 加密连接符合题目要求。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a web application that is backed by Amazon RDS. A new database administrator caused data loss by accidentally editing information in a database table. To help recover from this type of incident, the company wants the ability to restore the database to its state from 5 minutes before any change within the last 30 days. Which feature should the solutions architect include in the design to meet this requirement?

options.A: Read replicas
options.B: Manual snapshots
options.C: Automated backups
options.D: Multi-AZ deployments

explanations.A: Read replicas: 读副本用于提高数据库的读取性能和分担主数据库的负载，但它不提供数据恢复到特定时间点的功能。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Manual snapshots: 手动快照是用户手动创建的数据库备份，可以用于恢复数据。但手动快照无法满足题目中“恢复到5分钟前的状态”的需求，因为它需 要用户主动创建快照，无法提供连续的时间点恢复功能。因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Automated backups: 自动备份是Amazon RDS提供的功能，支持连续的时间点恢复（Point-in-Time Recovery），可以恢复到社去30天内的任意时间点。 这完全满足题目要求，因此此选项正确。
explanations.D: Multi-AZ deployments: 多可用区部署用于提高数据库的高可用性和容错能力，但它不提供数据恢复到特定时间点的功能。因此此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company’s web application consists of an Amazon API Gateway API in front of an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB database. The Lambda function handles the business logic, and the DynamoDB table hosts the data. The application uses Amazon Cognito user pools to identify the individual users of the application. A solutions architect needs to update the application so that only users who have a subscription can access premium content. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Enable API caching and throttling on the API Gateway API.
options.B: Set up AWS WAF on the API Gateway API. Create a rule to filter users who have a subscription. ££ API Gateway API
options.C: Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to the premium content in the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Implement API usage plans and API keys to limit the access of users who do not have a subscription.

explanations.A: Enable API caching and throttling on the API Gateway API. 错误：API缓存和限流主要用于优化性能和控制流量，而不是用于限制用户访问特定内容。 此选项无法满足“仅订阅用户访问高级内容”的需求。
explanations.B: Set up AWS WAF on the API Gateway API. Create a rule to filter users who have a subscription. 错误：AWS WAF主要用于保护API免受恶意流量攻击，而不是用于基于用户订阅状态进行访问控制。 创建规则来过滤订阅用户的复杂性较高，目操作开销较大。
explanations.C: Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to the premium content in the DynamoDB table. 错误：IAM权限可以控制对DynamoDB表的访问，但无法直接基于用户订阅状态进行动态控制。 实现此功能需要额外的逻辑和操作开销。
explanations.D: Implement API usage plans and API keys to limit the access of users who do not have a subscription. 正确：API使用计划和API密钥是API Gateway的内置功能，可以答案实现基于订阅状态的访问控制。 此解决方案操作开销最低，目直接满足题目需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is using Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to its UDP-based application for users around the world. The application is hosted on redundant servers in the company's on-premises data centers in the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company’s compliance requirements state that the application must be hosted on premises. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the application. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the NLBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.B: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the ALBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.C: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three NLBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS. fE= AWS
options.D: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three ALBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.

explanations.A: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the NLBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS. 分析： 使用NLB可以处理UDP流量，符合题目要求。 AWS Global Accelerator可以优化跨区域的性能和可用性，并支持UDP协议。 通过CNAME指向加速器DNS是正确的配置方式。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the ALBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS. 分析： ALB不支持UDP流量，仅支持HTTP/HTTPS协议，因此不符合题目要求。 虽然Global Accelerator可以优化性能，但ALB的协议限制使此选项错误。
explanations.C: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three NLBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS. 分析： 虽然NLB支持UDP流量，但CloudFront仅支持HTTP/HTTPS协议，不支持UDP流量。 Route 53的延迟路由可以优化性能，但结合CloudFront的使用不符合题目要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three ALBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS. 分析： ALB不支持UDP流量，仅支持HTTP/HTTPS协议，因此不符合题目要求。 CloudFront也不支持UDP流量，因此此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect wants all new users to have specific complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods for IAM user passwords. What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account. EET AWS
options.B: Set a password policy for each IAM user in the AWS account.
options.C: Use third-party vendor software to set password requirements.
options.D: Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event to set the password with the appropriate requirements. #3 Amazon CloudWatch

explanations.A: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account. 正确。AWS允许在账户级别设置密码策略，这样可以确保所有IAM用户都遵循统一的密码复杂性要求和轮换策略。 这是推荐的最佳实践，因为它简化了管理并提高了安全性。
explanations.B: Set a password policy for each IAM user in the AWS account. 错误。AWS不支持为单个IAM用户设置栘立的密码策略。密码策略只能在账户级别设置。
explanations.C: Use third-party vendor software to set password requirements. 错误。虽然可以使用第三方工具来管理密码，但这不是AWS推荐的解决方案，也不符合题目要求的“直接在AWS中实现”。
explanations.D: Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event to set the password with the appropriate requirements. 错误。CloudWatch规则无法直接设置密码策略。此选项不符合题目要求，也不是AWS推荐的实现方式。

question: Topic 1 A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 Linux instances. One of these EC2 instances runs several 1-hour tasks on a schedule. These tasks were written by different teams and have no common programming language. The company is concerned about performance and scalability while these tasks run on a single instance. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to resolve these concerns. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.B: Convert the EC2 instance to a container. Use AWS App Runner to create the container on demand to run the tasks as jobs.
options.C: Copy the tasks into AWS Lambda functions. Schedule the Lambda functions by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the EC2 instance that runs the tasks. Create an Auto Scaling group with the AMI to run multiple copies of the instance.

explanations.A: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). 正确：AWS Batch是专门设计用于运行批处理任务的服务，支持多种编程语言和任务类型，能够高效地管理资源并提供自动扩展能 力。 通过Amazon EventBridge可以答案调度任务，减少运维开销。 此选项满足性能和可扩展性要求，同时具有最低的操作开销。
explanations.B: Convert the EC2 instance to a container. Use AWS App Runner to create the container on demand to run the tasks as jobs. 错误：AWS App Runner主要用于运行Web应用程序或API，而不是批处理任务。 将EC2实例转换为容器需要额外的开发工作，增加了操作开销。 此选项不适合解决当前问题。
explanations.C: Copy the tasks into AWS Lambda functions. Schedule the Lambda functions by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). 错误：虽然AWS Lambda可以运行任务并通过EventBridge调度，但Lambda函数有运行时间限制（最大15分钟），不适合运行1小时 的任务。 此外，将任务迁移到Lambda需要重写代码，增加了开发和运维开销。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the EC2 instance that runs the tasks. Create an Auto Scaling group with the AMI to run multiple copies of the instance. 错误：虽然Auto Scaling可以扩展EC2实例，但这种方法无法解决任务调度问题。 运行多个实例会增加成本和管理复杂性，操作开销较高。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a public three-tier web application in a VPC. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances that run in private subnets need to communicate with a license server over the internet. The company needs a managed solution that minimizes operational maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Provision a NAT instance in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
options.B: Provision a NAT instance in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
options.C: Provision a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Provision a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.

explanations.A: Provision a NAT instance in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance. 正确性分析：NAT实例可以实现私有子网与互联网的通人，但它需要孅动管理（如实例的启动、监控、扩展等），因此不符合“托管 解决方案，减少运维工作”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Provision a NAT instance in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance. 正确性分析：NAT实例必须部署在公共子网中孆能访问互联网。如果部署在私有子网中，它无法与互联网通人，因此此选项技术上 不可行。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Provision a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway. 正确性分析：NAT网关是托管服务，AWS负责管理和维护。它需要部署在公共子网中，并通过路由表配置私有子网的默正路由指向 NAT网关。这是最佳实践，符合题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Provision a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway. 正确性分析：NAT网关必须部署在公共子网中孆能访问互联网。如果部署在私有子网中，它无法与互联网通人，因此此选项技术上 不可行。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to host a digital media streaming application. The EKS cluster will use a managed node group that is backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storage. The company must encrypt all data at rest by using a customer managed key that is stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Which combination of actions will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use a Kubernetes plugin that uses the customer managed key to perform data encryption.
options.B: After creation of the EKS cluster, locate the EBS volumes. Enable encryption by using the customer managed key.
options.C: Enable EBS encryption by default in the AWS Region where the EKS cluster will be created. Select the customer managed key as the default key.
options.D: Create the EKS cluster. Create an IAM role that has a policy that grants permission to the customer managed key. Associate the role with the EKS cluster.
options.E: Store the customer managed key as a Kubernetes secret in the EKS cluster. Use the customer managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes.

explanations.A: 使用一个 Kubernetes 插件，该插件使用客户管理密钥执行数据加密。 错误：虽然可以使用Kubernetes插件来实现加密，但这会增加额外的操作开销，并且不符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 在创建 EKS 集群后，定位 EBS 卷。使用客户管理密钥启用加密。 错误：手动定位EBS卷并启用加密需要额外的操作步骤，增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 在创建 EKS 集群的 AWS 区域中启用 EBS 默正加密。选择客户管理密钥作为默正密钥。 正确：启用EBS默正加密并选择客户管理密钥作为默正密钥是一个自动化的解决方案，减少了操作开销。
explanations.D: 创建 EKS 集群。创建一个具有授予客户管理密钥权限策略的 IAM 角色。将该角色与 EKS 集群关联。 正确：为EKS集群创建IAM角色并授予访问客户管理密钥的权限是实现加密的必要步骤，同时不会增加额外的操作开销。
explanations.E: 将客户管理密钥存储为 Kubernetes secret 在 EKS 集群中。使用客户管理密钥加密 EBS 卷。 错误：将密钥存储为Kubernetes secret并手动加密EBS卷增加了操作复杂性，不符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate an Oracle database to AWS. The database consists of a single table that contains millions of geographic information systems (GIS) images that are high resolution and are identified by a geographic code. When a natural disaster occurs, tens of thousands of images get updated every few minutes. Each geographic code has a single image or row that is associated with it. The company wants a solution that is highly available and scalable during such events. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the images and geographic codes in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.B: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Use Amazon DynamoDB with the geographic code as the key and the image S3 URL as the value.
options.C: Store the images and geographic codes in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) during times of high load.
options.D: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. store geographic codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.

explanations.A: Store the images and geographic codes in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. 错误：将大量高分违率图像存储在关系型数据库中（如 Oracle）会导致存储成本高昂目性能低下。 错误：虽然 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 提供高可用性，但它不适合存储大量非结构化数据（如图像）。
explanations.B: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Use Amazon DynamoDB with the geographic code as the key and the image S3 URL as the value. 正确：Amazon S3 是一种高效目成本低廉的存储解决方案，适合存储大量图像。 正确：Amazon DynamoDB 是一个高可用性和可扩展的 NoSQL 数据库，适合存储地理代畡和图像 URL 的映射关系。 正确：这种架构在高负载情况下能够快速扩展，同时保持成本效益。
explanations.C: Store the images and geographic codes in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) during times of high load. 错误：DynamoDB 不适合直接存储大量高分违率图像，因为其存储成本较高且性能不如 S3。 错误：虽然 DAX 可以提高 DynamoDB 的性能，但它无法解决存储图像的成本问题。
explanations.D: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Store geographic codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. 部分正确：将图像存储在 S3 是一个正确的选择。 错误：使用 Oracle 数据库存储地理代畡和图像 URL 的映射关系会导致成本较高，目性能不如 DynamoDB。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that collects data from loT sensors on automobiles. The data is streamed and stored in Amazon S3 through Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. The data produces trillions of S3 objects each year. Each morning, the company uses the data from the previous 30 days to retrain a suite of machine learning (ML) models. Four times each year, the company uses the data from the previous 12 months to perform analysis and train other ML models. The data must be available with minimal delay for up to 1 year. After 1 year, the data must be retained for archival purposes. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.B: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically move objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.C: Use the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.D: Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days, and then to $3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.

explanations.A: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 正确性分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering适合数据访问模式不确定的场景，但它的成本高于S3 Standard-IA，目生命周期策略与 Intelligent-Tiering的自动分层功能重复。 错误原因：不需要使用S3 Intelligent-Tiering，因为数据访问模式是明确的（30天频痏访问，之后较少访问）。
explanations.B: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类别。配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 自动在 1 年后将对象转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 正确性分析：S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以自动分层，但它的成本高于S3 Standard-IA，目无法直接配置将数据转移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 错误原因：S3 Intelligent-Tiering不支持直接转移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive，目成本不够优化。
explanations.C: 使用 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 正确性分析：S3 Standard-IA适合较少访问的数据，但没有考虑前30天频痏访问的需求，直接使用S3 Standard-IA会导致前30天的访 问成本增加。 错误原因：未优化前30天的存储成本，未充分利用S3 Standard存储类别。
explanations.D: 使用 S3 Standard 存储类别。创建一个 S3 生命周期策略，将对象在 30 天后转移到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，然后在 1 年后转移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。 正确性分析：S3 Standard适合前30天频痏访问的数据，S3 Standard-IA适合较少访问的数据，S3 Glacier Deep Archive适合长期归档 数据。 正确原因：此选项充分利用了S3存储类别的特点，并通过生命周期策略实现了成本优化。

question: Topic 1 A company is running several business applications in three separate VPCs within the us-east-1 Region. The applications must be able to communicate between VPCs. The applications also must be able to consistently send hundreds of gigabytes of data each day to a latency-sensitive application that runs in a single on-premises data center. A solutions architect needs to design a network connectivity solution that maximizes cost-effectiveness. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure three AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from the data center to AWS. Establish connectivity by configuring one VPN connection for each VPC.
options.B: Launch a third-party virtual network appliance in each VPC. Establish an IPsec VPN tunnel between the data center and each virtual appliance.
options.C: Set up three AWS Direct Connect connections from the data center to a Direct Connect gateway in us-east-1. Establish connectivity by configuring each VPC to use one of the Direct Connect connections.
options.D: Set up one AWS Direct Connect connection from the data center to AWS. Create a transit gateway, and attach each VPC to the transit gateway. Establish connectivity between the Direct Connect connection and the transit gateway.

explanations.A: 配置三个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接： 错误：虽然 Site-to-Site VPN 可以实现连接，但它是基于互联网的解决方案，可能会导致较高的延迟和不稳定性，尤其是对于每天 传输数百 GB 的数据和对延迟敏感的应用。 成本方面，VPN的费用较低，但性能无法满足需求。
explanations.B: 启动第三方虚拟网络设备并建立 IPsec VPN 隧道： 错误：这种方法复杂目需要额外的管理开销。第三方设备的成本较高，并且仍然基于互联网连接，无法保证低延迟和高知吐量。 不符合“最大化成本效益”的要求。
explanations.C: 设置三个 AWS Direct Connect 连接： 错误：虽然 Direct Connect 提供低延迟和高知吐量，但设置三个独立的 Direct Connect 连接会显著增加成本，不符合“最大化成本 效益”的要求。 Direct Connect Gateway可以支持多个VPC连接，因此不需要为每个VPC单独设置连接。
explanations.D: 设置一个 AWS Direct Connect 连接并使用 Transit Gateway： 正确：Direct Connect 提供低延迟和高知吐量，适合每天传输大量数据的场景。 Transit Gateway 可以连接多个 VPC，并通过 Direct Connect Gateway 实现与本地数据中心的连接。这种架构简化了管理，降低了成 本，同时满足性能需求。 符合“最大化成本效益”的要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company is building a distributed application that involves several serverless functions and AWS services to complete order-processing tasks. These tasks require manual approvals as part of the workflow. A solutions architect needs to design an architecture for the order-processing application. The solution must be able to combine multiple AWS Lambda functions into responsive serverless applications. The solution also must orchestrate data and services that run on Amazon EC2 instances, containers, or on-premises servers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Step Functions to build the application.
options.B: Integrate all the application components in an AWS Glue job.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to build the application.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EventBridge events to build the application.

explanations.A: Use AWS Step Functions to build the application. 正确：AWS Step Functions是一种服务器无关的编排服务，可以答案将多个AWS Lambda函数和其他服务组合成响应式应用程序。 Step Functions支持孅动孪批流程，并且可以与EC2实例、容器和本地服务器集成。 它提供了可视化工作流设计和状嬒管理，减少了操作开销。
explanations.B: Integrate all the application components in an AWS Glue job. 错误：AWS Glue主要用于ETL（提取、转换、加载）任务，适合处理数据转换和分析，而不是编排分害式应用程序。 它不支持孅动孪批流程，也不适合跨服务编排。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to build the application. 错误：Amazon SQS是消嬟队列服务，适合解兢组件和寢步通人，但不支持复杂的工作流编排。 孅动孪批流程和跨服务编排需要额外的逻辑和服务支持，增加了操作开销。
explanations.D: Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EventBridge events to build the application. 错误：虽然Lambda和EventBridge可以处理事件驱动的架构，但它们不提供内置的工作流编排功能。 孅动孪批流程需要额外的开发工作，增加了操作开销。

question: Topic 1 A company has launched an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Most of the connections to the database come from serverless applications. Application traffic to the database changes significantly at random intervals. At times of high demand, users report that their applications experience database connection rejection errors. Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a proxy in RDS Proxy. Configure the users' applications to use the DB instance through RDS Proxy.
options.B: Deploy Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the users’ applications and the DB instance.
