options.B: Add the development account as a principal in the trust policy of the role in the production account.
options.C: Turn off the S3 Block Public Access feature on the S3 bucket in the production account.
options.D: Create a user in the production account with unique credentials for each team member.

explanations.A: Attach the Administrator Access policy to the development account users. 错误：Administrator Access策略授予用户完全权限，这违反了最小权限原则。 不符合题目要求，因为题目要求的是跨账户访问，而不是在开发账户中授予社多权限。
explanations.B: Add the development account as a principal in the trust policy of the role in the production account. 正确：通过在生产账户的IAM角色人任策略中添加开发账户作为主体，可以允许开发账户中的用户通过角色访问生产账户的资源。 符合最小权限原则，因为只授予了访问生产账户S3橘的权限。
explanations.C: Turn off the S3 Block Public Access feature on the S3 bucket in the production account. 错误：关闭S3 Block Public Access功能会使S3橘变得公开访问，这不仅违反了最小权限原则，还可能导致安全问题。 与题目要求无关，因为题目要求的是跨账户访问，而不是公开访问。
explanations.D: Create a user in the production account with unique credentials for each team member. 错误：为每个团队成员创建用户会增加管理复杂性，并且不符合最小权限原则。 题目要求的是跨账户访问，而不是在生产账户中创建新用户。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and runs multiple Amazon EC2 workloads in the ap-southeast-2 Region. The company has a service control policy (SCP) that prevents any resources from being created in any other Region. A security policy requires the company to encrypt all data at rest. An audit discovers that employees have created Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for EC2 instances without encrypting the volumes. The company wants any new EC2 instances that any IAM user or root user launches in ap-southeast-2 to use encrypted EBS volumes. The company wants a solution that will have minimal effect on employees who create EBS volumes. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: In the Amazon EC2 console, select the EBS encryption account attribute and define a default encryption key. € Amazon EC2
options.B: Create an IAM permission boundary. Attach the permission boundary to the root organizational unit (OU). Define the boundary to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action when the ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.C: Create an SCP. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU). Define the SCP to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action whenthe ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.D: Update the IAM policies for each account to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action when the ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.E: In the Organizations management account, specify the Default EBS volume encryption setting.

explanations.A: 在 Amazon EC2 控制台中，选择 EBS 加密账户属性并定义默正加密密钥。 正确性分析：此选项可以设置默正加密，但它仅适用于单个账户，无法在组痣级别强制执行。 错误原因：题目要求对整个组痣的所有账户椹效，而此选项无法满足这一要求。
explanations.B: 创建一个 IAM 权限边相。将权限边相附加到根组织单元 (OU)。定义边相以在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操作。 正确性分析：IAM 权限边甩是用于限制特定用户或角色的权限，但它无法直接应用到整个组痣。 错误原因：权限边甩无法满足题目要求的组痣级别控制。
explanations.C: 创建一个 SCP。将 SCP 附加到根组织单元 (OU)。定义 SCP 以在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操 作。 正确性分析：SCP 是 AWS Organizations 中的功能，可以在组痣级别强制执行策略，符合题目要求。 正确原因：此选项可以确保所有账户都遵守加密要求。
explanations.D: 更新每个账户的 IAM 策略，以在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操作。 正确性分析：IAM 策略需要逐个账户配置，无法在组痣级别统一管理。 错误原因：此选项对员工操作影响较大，目不符合题目要求的“最小影响”条件。
explanations.E: 在 Organizations 管理账户中指定默正 EBS 卷加密设置。 正确性分析：此选项可以在组痣级别设置默正 EBS 加密，符合题目要求。 正确原因：此选项对员工操作影响最小，同时满足加密要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB cluster to simplify time-consuming database administrative tasks for production database workloads. The company wants to ensure that its database is highly available and will provide automatic failover support in most scenarios in less than 40 seconds. The company wants to offload reads off of the primary instance and keep costs as low as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Create one read replica and point the read workload to the read replica.
options.B: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB duster deployment Create two read replicas and point the read workload to the read replicas.
options.C: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Point the read workload to the secondary instances in the Multi-AZ pair. {FJ Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB
options.D: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment Point the read workload to the reader endpoint.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署。创建一个勀读副本，并将读劷工作负载指勖勀读副本。 正确性分析：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB实例部署提供高可用性，但只读副本是独立的实例，无法参与自动故障转移。虽然可以将读 取工作负载指向只读副本，但这并不满足“自动故障转移支持”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 集群部署。创建两个勀读副本，并将读劷工作负载指勖勀读副本。 正确性分析：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB Cluster支持自动故障转移，并且可以创建多个只读副本。但题目要求“尽可能降低成本”， 创建两个只读副本会增加成本，不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署。将读劷工作负载指勖 Multi-AZ 配对中的辅剸实例。 正确性分析：在Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB实例部署中，辅助实例仅用于故障转移，不能直接用于读取工作负载。因此此选项不符合 题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 集群部署。将读劷工作负载指勖 reader endpoint。 正确性分析：Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB Cluster支持自动故障转移，并提供一个专用的reader endpoint，用于分发读取工作负载。 这种方式既满足高可用性和自动故障转移的要求，又能优化读取工作负载并降低成本。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a highly available SFTP service. The SFTP service uses two Amazon EC2 Linux instances that run with elastic IP addresses to accept traffic from trusted IP sources on the internet. The SFTP service is backed by shared storage that is attached to the instances. User accounts are created and managed as Linux users in the SFTP servers. The company wants a serverless option that provides high IOPS performance and highly configurable security. The company also wants to maintain control over user permissions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a public endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the EBS volume to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.B: Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with elastic IP addresses and a VPC endpoint that has internet-facing access. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the EFS volume to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with default encryption enabled. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a public endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the S3 bucket to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with default encryption enabled. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a VPC endpoint that has internal access in a private subnet. Attach a security group that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the S3 bucket to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.

explanations.A: 创建加密的Amazon EBS卷并使用AWS Transfer Family SFTP服务： Amazon EBS是块存储，通常用于单个EC2实例，而不是共享存储。AWS Transfer Family无法直接附加EBS卷。 此选项不符合“高性能共享存储”的要求，因此错误。
explanations.B: 创建加密的Amazon EFS卷并使用AWS Transfer Family SFTP服务： Amazon EFS是共享文件存储，支持高IOPS性能，适合多实例访问。 AWS Transfer Family可以通过VPC端点与EFS集成，满足“高性能”和“安全性”的要求。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: 创建Amazon S3橘并使用AWS Transfer Family SFTP服务： Amazon S3是对象存储，虽然支持AWS Transfer Family，但不适合高IOPS场景。 此选项不符合“高性能存储”的要求，因此错误。
explanations.D: 创建Amazon S3橘并使用AWS Transfer Family SFTP服务（私有子网访问）： 与选项C类似，Amazon S3不适合高IOPS场景。 虽然安全性配置正确，但存储类型不符合要求，因此错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing a new machine learning (ML) model solution on AWS. The models are developed as independent microservices that fetch approximately 1 GB of model data from Amazon S3 at startup and load the data into memory. Users access the models through an asynchronous API. Users can send a request or a batch of requests and specify where the results should be sent. The company provides models to hundreds of users. The usage patterns for the models are irregular. Some models could be unused for days or weeks. Other models could receive batches of thousands of requests at a time. Which design should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Direct the requests from the API to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by the NLB.
options.B: Direct the requests from the API to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use AWS App Mesh to scale the instances of the ECS cluster based on the SQS queue size.
options.C: Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by SQS events. Use AWS Auto Scaling to increase the number of vCPUs for the Lambda functions based on the SQS queue size.
options.D: Direct the requests from the APl into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from the queue. Enable AWS Auto scaling on Amazon ECS IT

explanations.A: Direct the requests from the API to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by the NLB. 错误原因：Lambda函数不适合处理1GB的模型数据加载到内存的场景，因为Lambda的内存和执行时间有限（最大15分钟）。此 外，NLB通常用于处理TCP/UDP流量，而不是异桯API请求。
explanations.B: Direct the requests from the API to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use AWS App Mesh to scale the instances of the ECS cluster based on the SQS queue size. 错误原因：虽然ALB和ECS的组合是有效的，但使用AWS App Mesh来扩展ECS实例并不是最佳选择。AWS App Mesh主要用于服务 间通人，而不是直接扩展ECS实例。此外，ALB的使用在此场景中并不必要，因为请求已经通过SQS队列进行异桯处理。
explanations.C: Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by SQS events. Use AWS Auto Scaling to increase the number of vCPUs for the Lambda functions based on the SQS queue size. 错误原因：Lambda函数仍然不适合处理1GB的模型数据加载到内存的场景。Lambda的内存和执行时间限制使其无法满足需求。此 外，Lambda无法直接通过Auto Scaling增加vCPU数量。
explanations.D: Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from the queue. Enable AWS Auto Scaling on Amazon ECS for both the cluster and copies of the service based on the queue size. 正确原因：此选项使用了SQS队列来处理异桯API请求，并通过ECS服务来加载模型数据。ECS支持处理大规模数据加载到内存的场 景，并且可以通过AWS Auto Scaling根据队列大小动态扩展服务实例和集群容量。这种设计满足了不规则使用模式和高并发请求的 需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a custom application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. The application has frontend nodes that need to run 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and backend nodes that need to run only for a short time based on workload. The number of backend nodes varies during the day. The company needs to scale out and scale in more instances based on workload. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWs Fargate for the backend nodes.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.
options.C: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Reserved Instances for the backend nodes.
options.D: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.

explanations.A: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes. 正确性分析：Reserved Instances适合长期运行的工作负载，因此前端节点使用Reserved Instances是正确的选择。 错误点：AWS Fargate主要用于容器化工作负载，而题目中并未提到后端节点是容器化的应用。此外，Fargate的成本通常高于Spot Instances，不是最具成本效益的选择。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes. 正确性分析：Reserved Instances适合长期运行的工作负载，因此前端节点使用Reserved Instances是正确的选择。 正确性分析：Spot Instances适合短期、可中断的工作负载，目成本最低，因此后端节点使用Spot Instances是最具成本效益的选 择。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Reserved Instances for the backend nodes. 错误点：前端节点需要24/7运行，Spot Instances可能会被中断，不适合这种场景。 错误点：后端节点是短期工作负载，使用Reserved Instances会导致资源梸费，成本较高。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes. 错误点：前端节点需要24/7运行，Spot Instances可能会被中断，不适合这种场景。 错误点：AWS Fargate成本较高，目题目未提到后端节点是容器化工作负载。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses high block storage capacity to runs its workloads on premises. The company's daily peak input and output transactions per second are not more than 15,000 IOPS. The company wants to migrate the workloads to Amazon EC2 and to provision disk performance independent of storage capacity. Which Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume type will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: GP2 volume type GP2
options.B: io2 volume type io2
options.C: GP3 volume type GP3

explanations.A: GP2 volume type GP2卷类型的性能与存储容量相关联，IOPS輮存储容量增加而增加。虽然GP2可以支持高IOPS，但无法独立于存储容量进行性能配 置，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: io2 volume type io2卷类型提供高性能和高耐久性，支持独立配置IOPS，但成本较高。题目要求“最具成本效益”的解决方案，因此io2不是最佳选 择。
explanations.C: GP3 volume type GP3卷类型支持独立配置IOPS和知吐量，与存储容量无关。GP3的成本比io1和io2更低，同时可以满足15,000 IOPS的需求，因此是 最具成本效益的选择。
explanations.D: io1 volume type io1卷类型支持高性能和独立配置IOPS，但成本较高。与io2类似，io1不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to store data from its healthcare application. The application's data frequently changes. A new regulation requires audit access at all levels of the stored data. The company hosts the application on an on-premises infrastructure that is running out of storage capacity. A solutions architect must securely migrate the existing data to AWS while satisfying the new regulation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.B: Use AWS Snowcone to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.

explanations.A: Use AWS DataSync to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events. 正确： AWS DataSync是专门设计用于高效、安全地迁移数据到AWS的服务，适合处理频痏变化的数据。 Amazon S3是一个高可用、高持久性的存储服务，适合存储医田数据。 AWS CloudTrail可以记录数据事件，满足审计需求。
explanations.B: Use AWS Snowcone to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events. 错误： AWS Snowcone适用于小规模数据迁移，但题目未提到数据量大小，目Snowcone不适合频痏变化的数据。 CloudTrail的管理事件记录的是账户级别的操作，而不是数据级别的操作，无法满足审计需求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events. 错误： Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration适用于加速跨区域数据上传，但题目未提到跨区域场景。 虽然CloudTrail可以记录数据事件，但Transfer Acceleration不是最佳迁移工具。
explanations.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events. 错误： AWS Storage Gateway适用于混合云存储场景，但题目要求迁移数据，而不是持痲访问本地数据。 CloudTrail的管理事件无法满足数据级别的审计需求。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is implementing a complex Java application with a MySQL database. The Java application must be deployed on Apache Tomcat and must be highly available. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application in AWS Lambda. Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to connect with the Lambda functions.
options.B: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configure a load-balanced environment and a rolling deployment policy.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon ElastiCache. Configure the ElastiCache security group to allow access from the application.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Install a MySQL server on the EC2 instance. Configure the application on the server. Create an AMI. Use the AMI to create a launch template with an Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Deploy the application in AWS Lambda. Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to connect with the Lambda functions. 错误：AWS Lambda适用于无服务器架构，但题目明确要求部署一个复杂的Java应用程序，这种应用通常需要持久运行的环境（如 Tomcat），而Lambda不适合运行复杂的Java应用。 此外，Lambda无法直接满足高可用性和负载均衡的需求，目与MySQL数据库的连接需要额外的配置。
explanations.B: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configure a load-balanced environment and a rolling deployment policy. 正确：Elastic Beanstalk是一个托管服务，支持Java应用程序的部署，并且可以自动配置负载均衡和高可用性环境。 滚动部署策略可以确保应用程序的更新不会中断服务，符合高可用性要求。 Elastic Beanstalk还支持Tomcat作为运行环境，非常适合题目中的需求。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to Amazon ElastiCache. Configure the ElastiCache security group to allow access from the application. 错误：Amazon ElastiCache是一个内存缓存服务，适用于加速数据库查询或存储临时数据，但不能蔡代MySQL数据库。 题目要求的是MySQL数据库，而不是缓存服务，因此此选项不符合需求。
explanations.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Install a MySQL server on the EC2 instance. Configure the application on the server. Create an AMI. Use the AMI to create a launch template with an Auto Scaling group. 错误：虽然这种方法可以实现高可用性，但需要手动配置和管理EC2实例、负载均衡器、Auto Scaling组等，复杂度较高。 Elastic Beanstalk可以自动处理这些任务，因此更适合题目要求的场景。

question: Topic 1 A serverless application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. The Lambda function needs permissions to read and write to the DynamoDB table. Which solution will give the Lambda function access to the DynamoDB table MOST securely?

options.A: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access_key_id and secret_access_key parameters as part of the Lambda environment variables. Ensure that other AWS users do not have read and write access to the Lambda function configuration.
options.B: Create an IAM role that includes Lambda as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the new role as the execution role.
options.C: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access_key_id and secret_access_key parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Update the Lambda function code to retrieve the secure string parameters before connecting to the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Create an IAM role that includes DynamoDB as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access from the Lambda function. Update the code of the Lambda function to attach to the new role as an execution role.

explanations.A: 创建一个具有编程访问权限的 IAM 用户供 Lambda 函数使用。 错误：使用 IAM 用户并将 access_key_id 和 secret_access_key 存储在 Lambda 环境变量中存在安全风险。环境变量可能被意外暴 需，违反安全性最佳实践。
explanations.B: 创建一个包含 Lambda 作为可人服务的 IAM 角色。 正确：这是 AWS 推荐的最佳实践。通过为 Lambda 函数分配 IAM 角色，Lambda 可以安全地访问 DynamoDB，而无需显式存储赁 确。
explanations.C: 创建一个具有编程访问权限的 IAM 用户供 Lambda 函数使用。 错误：虽然使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 存储认证比直接存储在环境变量中更安全，但仍然不如使用 IAM 角色安 全。IAM 用户的认证可能被泄需。
explanations.D: 创建一个包含 DynamoDB 作为可人服务的 IAM 角色。 错误：IAM 角色的人任关系应该是 Lambda，而不是 DynamoDB。DynamoDB 不需要成为可人服务。

question: Topic 1 The following IAM policy is attached to an IAM group. This is the only policy applied to the group. "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "$id": “1°, "Effect": “Allow”, "Action": "ec23*", “Resource“: “*", “Condition”: { “StringEquals”: { “ec2:Region": “us-east-1° ) ]， { "Sid": “2°, "Effect": “Deny”, "Action": [ “ec2:StopiInstances", “ec2:TerminateInstances” ‘Respuxce*: bath bay “Condition”: [( “BoollfExists": {“aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent”: false) ) } ] } What are the effective IAM permissions of this policy for group members?

options.A: Group members are permitted any Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. Statements after the Allow permission are not applied.
options.B: Group members are denied any Amazon EC2 permissions in the us-east-1 Region unless they are logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
options.C: Group members are allowed the ec2:Stoplnstances and ec2:Terminatelnstances permissions for all Regions when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action.
options.D: Group members are allowed the ec2:Stoplnstances and ec2:Terminatelnstances permissions for the us-east-1 Region only when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. (ENA)

explanations.A: Group members are permitted any Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. Statements after the Allow permission are not applied. 错误：IAM策略的评估顺序是所有语句都会被评估，目拒绝（Deny）权限优先于允许（Allow）。因此，后续的拒绝语句会影响最 终权限。
explanations.B: Group members are denied any Amazon EC2 permissions in the us-east-1 Region unless they are logged in with multi- factor authentication (MFA). 错误：策略中明确允许了所有 EC2 操作（ec2:*）在 us-east-1 区域内执行，只有特定的操作（ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances）在未使用 MFA 时被拒绝。
explanations.C: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for all Regions when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action. 错误：策略中的允许语句明确限制了操作范围为 us-east-1 区域，因此其他区域的权限不适用。
explanations.D: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for the us-east-1 Region only when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. 正确：策略的第一条语句允许所有 EC2 操作在 us-east-1 区域内执行。第二条语句拒绝了 ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances 操作，除非用户使用了 MFA。因此，最终权限符合描述。

question: Topic 1 A manufacturing company has machine sensors that upload .csv files to an Amazon S3 bucket. These .csv files must be converted into images and must be made available as soon as possible for the automatic generation of graphical reports. The images become irrelevant after 1 month, but the .csv files must be kept to train machine learning (ML) models twice a year. The ML trainings and audits are planned weeks in advance. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Launch an Amazon EC2 Spot Instance that downloads the .csv files every hour, generates the image files, and uploads the images to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Design an AWS Lambda function that converts the .csv files into images and stores the images in the S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function when a .csv file is uploaded.
options.C: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.
options.D: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.
options.E: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Keep the image files in Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS). IT

explanations.A: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 Spot Instance，每小时下载 .csv 文件，生成图像文件，并将图像上传到 S3 存储橘。 错误：EC2 Spot Instance虽然成本较低，但需要手动管理实例的生命周期，目无法保证实例的持痲可用性。相比之下，AWS Lambda更适合事件驱动的任务处理。
explanations.B: 设计一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将 .csv 文件转换为图像，并将图像存储在 S3 存储橘中。当 .csv 文件上传时调用 Lambda 范 数。 正确：AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，支持事件驱动架构，可以在文件上传到S3时自动触发处理任务。Lambda的成本按使用量 计费，非常适合这种场景。
explanations.C: 为 S3 存储橘中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 生命周期规则。将 .csv 文件从 S3 Standard 转移到 S3 Glacier，在上传后 1 天进 行转换。将图像文件在 30 天后过期。 正确：S3 Lifecycle规则可以自动管理文件的存储类型和过期时间。将.csv文件转移到S3 Glacier可以显著降低存储成本，而图像文件 在30天后过期符合需求。
explanations.D: 为 S3 存储橘中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 生命周期规则。将 .csv 文件从 S3 Standard 转移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)，在上传后 1 天进行转换。将图像文件在 30 天后过期。 错误：S3 One Zone-IA虽然成本较低，但不具备高可用性，数据存储在单一可用区，存在数据丢失风险。相比之下，S3 Glacier更适 合长期存储目成本更低。
explanations.E: 为 S3 存储橘中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 生命周期规则。将 .csv 文件从 S3 Standard 转移到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，在上传后 1 天进行转换。将图像文件保留在 Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS)。 错误：Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS)已被AWS弃用，不推荐使用。S3 Standard-IA虽然适合不频痏访问的数据，但成本高于 S3 Glacier，不符合成本优化的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has developed a new video game as a web application. The application is in a three-tier architecture in a VPC with Amazon RDS for MySQL in the database layer. Several players will compete concurrently online. The game's developers want to display a top-10 scoreboard in near-real time and offer the ability to stop and restore the game while preserving the current scores. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster to cache the scores for the web application to display.
options.B: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to compute and cache the scores for the web application to display.
options.C: Place an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the web application to cache the scoreboard in a section of the application.
options.D: Create a read replica on Amazon RDS for MySQL to run queries to compute the scoreboard and serve the read traffic to the web application.

explanations.A: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster to cache the scores for the web application to display. Memcached是一个高性能的分布式内存对象缓存系统，适合简单的键值存储和缓存场景。 然而，题目要求“计算和缓存分数”，Memcached不支持复杂的数据结构和计算功能，因此不适合此场景。 错误原因：Memcached无法满足计算需求。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to compute and cache the scores for the web application to display. Redis支持丰富的数据结构（如Sorted Sets），可以答案实现排行榜功能。 Redis还支持持久化功能，可以在游戏停止和恢复时保留当前分数。 正确原因：Redis完全满足题目要求，包括计算、缓存和持久化功能。
explanations.C: Place an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the web application to cache the scoreboard in a section of the application. CloudFront是一个内容分发网络（CDN），主要用于缓存静态内容以提高全球访问速度。 题目要求的是“计算和缓存分数”，而不是静态内容的分发，因此CloudFront不适合此场景。 错误原因：CloudFront无法处理动态计算需求。
explanations.D: Create a read replica on Amazon RDS for MySQL to run queries to compute the scoreboard and serve the read traffic to the web application. RDS读副本可以分担读取压力，但它仍然需要通过SQL查询来计算排行榜，效率较低。 题目要求“邮实时”显示排行榜，使用数据库查询可能无法满足性能要求。 错误原因：数据库查询效率较低，无法满足实时性需求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company wants to use machine learning (ML) algorithms to build and train models. The company will use the models to visualize complex scenarios and to detect trends in customer data. The architecture team wants to integrate its ML models with a reporting platform to analyze the augmented data and use the data directly in its business intelligence dashboards. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Glue to create an ML transform to build and train models. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to visualize the data.
options.B: Use Amazon SageMaker to build and train models. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
options.C: Use a pre-built ML Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the AWS Marketplace to build and train models. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to visualize the data.
options.D: Use Amazon QuickSight to build and train models by using calculated fields. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Glue创建一个ML转换来构建和训练模型。使用Amazon OpenSearch Service来可视化数据。 错误：AWS Glue主要用于ETL任务，而不是专门设计用于构建和训练机器字习模型。虽然AWS Glue有ML转换功能，但它的用途有 限，无法满足复杂的机器字习需求。 错误：Amazon OpenSearch Service主要用于搜索和分析数据，而不是专门设计用于商业智能可视化。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon SageMaker构建和训练模型。使用Amazon QuickSight来可视化数据。 正确：Amazon SageMaker是AWS专门设计的机器字习服务，能够高效地构建、训练和部署模型，满足复杂的机器字习需求。 正确：Amazon QuickSight是AWS的商业智能工具，能够直接集成数据并进行可视化分析，适合用于商业智能仪表板。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Marketplace中的预构建ML Amazon Machine Image（AMI）来构建和训练模型。使用Amazon OpenSearch Service来可视化数据。 错误：虽然AWS Marketplace的预构建AMI可以嬎速部署机器字习环境，但它需要用户孅动管理和维护，增加了操作开销。 错误：Amazon OpenSearch Service不适合用于商业智能可视化。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon QuickSight通过计算字段来构建和训练模型。使用Amazon QuickSight来可视化数据。 错误：Amazon QuickSight是一个数据可视化工具，不适合用于构建和训练机器字习模型。 正确：Amazon QuickSight可以用于数据可视化，但它无法完成机器字习任务。

question: Topic 1 A company is running its production and nonproduction environment workloads in multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to design a solution that will prevent the modification of cost usage tags. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a custom AWS Config rule to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.
options.B: Create a custom trail in AWS CloudTrail to prevent tag modification.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.
options.D: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch logs to prevent tag modification.

explanations.A: Create a custom AWS Config rule to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals. 错误：AWS Config主要用于资源的合规性检查和记录资源配置的变化，但它无法直接阻止操作（如标疮修改）。它可以检测违规行 为，但不能主动防止标疮修改。
explanations.B: Create a custom trail in AWS CloudTrail to prevent tag modification. 错误：AWS CloudTrail用于记录API调用和活动日志，帮助审计和畁控，但它无法直接阻止操作（如标疮修改）。
explanations.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals. 正确：SCP是AWS Organizations中的一种策略，可以限制或允许组痣中账户的操作。通过SCP，可以明确限制标疮修改操作，确保 只有授权的主体可以执行此操作。
explanations.D: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch logs to prevent tag modification. 错误：CloudWatch Logs用于畁控和记录日志数据，但它无法直接阻止操作（如标疮修改）。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer in an Auto Scaling group and with an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants to ensure the application can be made available in anotherAWS Region with minimal downtime. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of downtime?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and a load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, load balancers, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when needed Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and a load balancer to be launched when needed. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to trigger an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 pointing to the disaster recovery load balancer.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and a load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer. 分析： 在灾难恢复区域创建Auto Scaling组和负载均衡器可以确保应用程序在该区域能够快速启动并运行。 将DynamoDB表配置为全球表可以实现跨区域数据同步，确保数据一致性。 配置DNS故障转移可以在主区域不可用时快速切换到灾难恢复区域。 此选项符合题目要求，并且实现了最小的停机时间。 正确。
explanations.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, load balancers, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when needed. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer. 分析： 使用CloudFormation模板可以快速部署资源，但需要在灾难发生时手动启动资源，可能导致较长的停机时间。 没有提前配置DynamoDB全球表，数据同步可能会出现问题。 此选项不符合“最小停机时间”的要求。 错误。
explanations.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and a load balancer to be launched when needed. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer. 分析： 虽然配置了DynamoDB全球表，但使用CloudFormation模板在灾难发生时启动资源仍然会导致较长的停机时间。 此选项不符合“最小停机时间”的要求。 错误。
explanations.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to trigger an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 pointing to the disaster recovery load balancer. 分析： 创建Auto Scaling组和负载均衡器以及配置DynamoDB全球表是正确的步骤。 使用CloudWatch和Lambda函数来更新Route 53的DNS记录是一种自动化方法，但相比直接配置DNS故障转移，复杂性更高且可能 增加延迟。 此选项不符合“最小停机时间”的要求。 错误。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to migrate a MySQL database from its on-premises data center to AWS within 2 weeks. The database is 20 TB in size. The company wants to complete the migration with minimal downtime. Which solution will migrate the database MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with replication of ongoing changes. Send the Snowball Edge device to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication.
options.B: Order an AWS Snowmobile vehicle. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with ongoing changes. Send the Snowmobile vehicle back to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication.
options.C: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU device. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with ongoing changes. Send the Snowball device to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication
options.D: Order a 1 GB dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection to establish a connection with the data center. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with replication of ongoing changes.

explanations.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device... 分析：此选项使用 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备进行迁移，结合 AWS DMS 和 AWS SCT 实现数据库迁移和持续复 制。Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 专为大规模数据迁移设计，支持高效传输 20 TB 数据，目成本较低。此方法适合需要快速迁 移目网络带宽有限的场景。 正确性：正确。
explanations.B: Order an AWS Snowmobile vehicle... 分析：AWS Snowmobile 是一种用于迁移 PB 级数据的解决方案，适用于超大规模数据迁移。20 TB 数据量辧低于 Snowmobile 的设 计容量，使用 Snowmobile 会导致资源浪费目成本较高。 正确性：错误。
explanations.C: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU device... 分析：Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 设备主要用于需要计算能力的场景（如机器学习或视频处理），而不是专为数据迁移设 计。此选项不符合题目需求，目成本高于 Storage Optimized 设备。 正确性：错误。
explanations.D: Order a 1 GB dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection... 分析：Direct Connect 提供稳定的网络连接，但迁移 20 TB 数据可能需要较长时间，尤其是在两周内完成迁移的要求下。此方法可 能无法满足时间要求，目成本较高。 正确性：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company moved its on-premises PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company successfully launched a new product. The workload on the database has increased. The company wants to accommodate the larger workload without adding infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance larger.
options.B: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance a Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.C: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Add another Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance.
options.D: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance an on-demand DB instance.

explanations.A: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance larger. 正确：预留实例可以显著降低成本，适合长期稳定的工作负载。 正确：扩容现有实例是直接提升性能的有效方法，尤其是在单实例的情况下。 此选项既解决了性能问题，又优化了成本，是最符合题目要求的解决方案。
explanations.B: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance a Multi-AZ DB instance. 错误：Multi-AZ主要用于提高可用性和容错能力，而不是直接提升性能。 此选项无法解决性能问题，也没有提到成本优化。
explanations.C: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Add another Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. 部分正确：预留实例可以降低成本。 错误：添加另一个实例需要额外的基础设施和配置（如读写分离），并不符合题目要求的“无需添加基础设施”。
explanations.D: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance an on-demand DB instance. 错误：按需实例成本较高，不适合长期稳定的工作负载。 此选项既没有解决性能问题，也没有优化成本。

question: Topic 1 A company operates an ecommerce website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in an Auto Scaling group. The site is experiencing performance issues related to a high request rate from illegitimate external systems with changing IP addresses. The security team is worried about potential DDoS attacks against the website. The company must block the illegitimate incoming requests in a way that has a minimal impact on legitimate users. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Deploy Amazon Inspector and associate it with the ALB.
options.B: Deploy AWS WAF, associate it with the ALB, and configure a rate-limiting rule. ABS AWS WAF
options.C: Deploy rules to the network ACLs associated with the ALB to block the incomingtraffic.
options.D: Deploy Amazon GuardDuty and enable rate-limiting protection when configuring GuardDuty. #8 Amazon GuardDuty

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon Inspector and associate it with the ALB. Amazon Inspector 是一种自动化的安全评估服务，用于检查 EC2 实例的漏洞和错误配置。 它不适用于实时流量管理或防止 DDoS 攻击，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS WAF, associate it with the ALB, and configure a rate-limiting rule. AWS WAF 是一种 Web 应用程序防火墙，可以保护应用免受常见的 Web 漏洞和 DDoS 攻击。 通过配置速率限制规则，可以有效地阻止高请求率的非法流量，同时对合法用户寸响最小。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Deploy rules to the network ACLs associated with the ALB to block the incoming traffic. 网络 ACL 是一种基于 IP 的流量控制机制，但它无法动嬒处理 DDoS 攻击中不断变化的 IP 地址。 此外，网络 ACL 的规则管理较为复杂，可能会寸响合法用户的访问。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy Amazon GuardDuty and enable rate-limiting protection when configuring GuardDuty. Amazon GuardDuty 是一种威胁检测服务，用于识别潜在的嬡嬯活动，但它不提供速率限制功能。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to share accounting data with an external auditor. The data is stored in an Amazon RDS DB instance that resides in a private subnet. The auditor has its own AWS account and requires its own copy of the database. What is the MOST secure way for the company to share the database with the auditor?

options.A: Create a read replica of the database. Configure IAM standard database authentication to grant the auditor access.
options.B: Export the database contents to text files. Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create a new IAM user for the auditor. Grant the user access to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Copy a snapshot of the database to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an IAM user. Share the user's keys with the auditor to grant access to the object in the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an encrypted snapshot of the database. Share the snapshot with the auditor. Allow access to the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key.

explanations.A: Create a read replica of the database. Configure IAM standard database authentication to grant the auditor access. 错误：RDS的只读副本仍然需要网络访问权限，而题目中明确指出数据寑位于私有子网中，外部孪计员无法直接访问。 此外，IAM标准数据寑正确无法直接解决跨账户访问的问题。
explanations.B: Export the database contents to text files. Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create a new IAM user for the auditor. Grant the user access to the S3 bucket. 错误：虽然这种方法可以实现数据共享，但导出数据到文本文件并存储在S3中可能会导致数据泄轄轢輩。 此外，创建新的IAM用户并授予访问权限并不是最安全的方式，完其是涉及跨账户的场景。
explanations.C: Copy a snapshot of the database to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an IAM user. Share the user's keys with the auditor to grant access to the object in the S3 bucket. 错误：将数据寑嬎照复制到S3并共享IAM用户密迫的方式存在安全輯嬣。 共享IAM用户密迫不符合AWS的最佳安全实践。
explanations.D: Create an encrypted snapshot of the database. Share the snapshot with the auditor. Allow access to the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. 正确：通过创建加密嬎照并共享嬎照，可以安全地将数据提供给外部孪计员。 允许访问AWS KMS加密密迫确保数据在传输和存储过程中保持加密状嬒。 这种方法符合AWS的最佳实践，并且提供了最高的安全性。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect configured a VPC that has a small range of IP addresses. The number of Amazon EC2 instances that are in the VPC is increasing, and there is an insufficient number of IP addresses for future workloads. Which solution resolves this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Add an additional IPv4 CIDR block to increase the number of IP addresses and create additional subnets in the VPC. Create new resources in the new subnets by using the new CIDR.
options.B: Create a second VPC with additional subnets. Use a peering connection to connect the second VPC with the first VPC Update the routes and create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC.
options.C: Use AWS Transit Gateway to add a transit gateway and connect a second VPC with the first VPUpdate the routes of the transit gateway and VPCs. Create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC.
options.D: Create a second VPC. Create a Site-to-Site VPN connection between the first VPC and the second VPC by using a VPN- hosted solution on Amazon EC2 and a virtual private gateway. Update the route between VPCs to the traffic through the VPN. Create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC.

explanations.A: Add an additional IPv4 CIDR block to increase the number of IP addresses and create additional subnets in the VPC. Create new resources in the new subnets by using the new CIDR. 正确：AWS允许为现有VPC添加额外的IPv4 CIDR块，从而扩展IP地址范围。 操作开销低：无需创建新的VPC或复杂的网络连接，只需更新现有VPC的配置。 符合题目要求：直接解决IP地址不足的问题。
explanations.B: Create a second VPC with additional subnets. Use a peering connection to connect the second VPC with the first VPC. Update the routes and create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC. 错误：创建第二个VPC并设置VPC对等连接会增加操作复杂性。 需要更新路由表和管理两个VPC，操作开销较高。 虽然可以解决问题，但不是最优解。
explanations.C: Use AWS Transit Gateway to add a transit gateway and connect a second VPC with the first VPC. Update the routes of the transit gateway and VPCs. Create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC. 错误：使用AWS Transit Gateway是一个复杂的解决方案，适用于多个VPC之间的连接。 操作开销高：需要配置Transit Gateway和更新路由表。 不符合题目要求：题目仅要求解决IP地址不足的问题，而不是管理多个VPC的连接。
explanations.D: Create a second VPC. Create a Site-to-Site VPN connection between the first VPC and the second VPC by using a VPN- hosted solution on Amazon EC2 and a virtual private gateway. Update the route between VPCs to the traffic through the VPN. Create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC. 错误：使用Site-to-Site VPN连接会显著增加操作复杂性。 需要额外的EC2实例和VPN配置，成本和管理开销较高。 不符合题目要求：题目要求最小操作开销的解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company used an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance during application testing. Before terminating the DB instance at the end of the test cycle, a solutions architect created two backups. The solutions architect created the first backup by using the mysqldump utility to create a database dump. The solutions architect created the second backup by enabling the final DB snapshot option on RDS termination. The company is now planning for a new test cycle and wants to create a new DB instance from the most recent backup. The company has chosen a MySQL-compatible edition ofAmazon Aurora to host the DB instance. Which solutions will create the new DB instance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Import the RDS snapshot directly into Aurora.
options.B: Upload the RDS snapshot to Amazon S3. Then import the RDS snapshot into Aurora.
options.C: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then import the database dump into Aurora.
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the RDS snapshot into Aurora.
options.E: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the database dump into Aurora.

explanations.A: Import the RDS snapshot directly into Aurora. 错误：Amazon Aurora不支持直接导入RDS快照。Aurora和RDS虽然兼容，但快照格式不同，无法直接导入。
explanations.B: Upload the RDS snapshot to Amazon S3. Then import the RDS snapshot into Aurora. 错误：将RDS快照上传到Amazon S3后无法直接导入到Aurora。Aurora不支持这种迁移路径。
explanations.C: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then import the database dump into Aurora. 正确：使用mysqldump创建的数据库转储可以上传到Amazon S3，然后通过Aurora的导入功能将数据导入到Aurora。
explanations.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the RDS snapshot into Aurora. 错误：AWS DMS不支持直接从RDS快照迁移到Aurora。DMS通常用于实时数据迁移或从活动数据库迁移。
explanations.E: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the database dump into Aurora. 错误：虽然可以使用DMS进行迁移，但DMS通常用于活动数据库的迁移，而不是直接从数据库转储文件进行迁移。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a multi-tier web application on Amazon Linux Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company observes that the Auto Scaling group launches more On-Demand Instances when the application's end users access high volumes of static web content. The company wants to optimize cost. What should a solutions architect do to redesign the application MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Update the Auto Scaling group to use Reserved Instances instead of On-Demand Instances.
options.B: Update the Auto Scaling group to scale by launching Spot Instances instead of On-Demand Instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to host the static web contents from an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function behind an Amazon API Gateway APl to host the static website contents.

explanations.A: Update the Auto Scaling group to use Reserved Instances instead of On-Demand Instances. 错误：Reserved Instances可以降低成本，但它们是长期承诺的实例类型，无法动态应对流量的变化。 此外，问题中提到的高流量主要是静态内容访问，使用Reserved Instances并不能解决根本问题。
explanations.B: Update the Auto Scaling group to scale by launching Spot Instances instead of On-Demand Instances. 部分正确：Spot Instances确实可以显著降低成本，但它们的价格和可用性不稳定，可能会影响应用的可靠性。 此外，这种方法仍然依赖EC2实例来处理静态内容，而不是优化静态内容的交付方式。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to host the static web contents from an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确：将静态内容托管在Amazon S3中，并通过Amazon CloudFront分发，可以显著降低成本，同时提高性能和可扩展性。 CloudFront是专门设计用于优化静态内容交付的服务，能够减少对EC2实例的依赖。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function behind an Amazon API Gateway API to host the static website contents. 错误：虽然Lambda和API Gateway可以用于托管动态内容，但它们并不是静态内容托管的最佳选择。 这种方法可能会增加复杂性和成本，而不是优化成本。

question: Topic 1 A company stores several petabytes of data across multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Lake Formation to manage its data lake. The company's data science team wants to securely share selective data from its accounts with the company's engineering team for analytical purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Copy the required data to a common account. Create an IAM access role in that account. Grant access by specifying a permission policy that includes users from the engineering team accounts as trusted entities.
options.B: Use the Lake Formation permissions Grant command in each account where the data is stored to allow the required engineering team users to access the data.
options.C: Use AWS Data Exchange to privately publish the required data to the required engineering team accounts.
options.D: Use Lake Formation tag-based access control to authorize and grant cross-account permissions for the required data to the engineering team accounts.

explanations.A: 将所需数据复制到一个公共账户。在该账户中创建一个IAM访问角色。通过指定包含工程团队账户用户作为可人实体的权限策略 来授予访问权限。 错误：此方法需要将数据复制到一个公共账户，增加了存储成本和操作开销。 此外，IAM角色的权限管理复杂，可能导致安全风险。
explanations.B: 在存储数据的每个账户中使用Lake Formation权限Grant命令，允许所需的工程团队用户访问数据。 错误：虽然Lake Formation支持Grant命令，但在多个账户中逐一配置权限会增加操作开销。 此方法不符合“最低操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Data Exchange将所需数据私密发布到所需的工程团队账户。 错误：AWS Data Exchange主要用于数据订阅和分发，而不是直接管理数据湖的权限。 此方法不适合Lake Formation场景，目操作复杂。
explanations.D: 使用Lake Formation基于标签的访问控制来授权并为工程团队账户授予跨账户权限访问所需数据。 正确：Lake Formation支持基于标签的访问控制（TBAC），可以简化跨账户权限管理。 此方法操作简单，符合“最低操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to host a scalable web application on AWS. The application will be accessed by users from different geographic regions of the world. Application users will be able to download and upload unique data up to gigabytes in size. The development team wants a cost-effective solution to minimize upload and download latency and maximize performance. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 with Transfer Acceleration to host the application.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 with CacheControl headers to host the application.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling and Amazon CloudFront to host the application.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling and Amazon ElastiCache to host the application.

explanations.A: Use Amazon S3 with Transfer Acceleration to host the application. 正确：Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration通过使用AWS的全球加速网络，显著减少了用户上传和下载大文件的延迟，特别是对于跨地 域的用户。 Transfer Acceleration是专门设计用于优化数据传输性能的功能，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon S3 with CacheControl headers to host the application. 错误：CacheControl headers主要用于控制浏览器或中间缓存的行为，虽然可以优化缓存性能，但无法显著减少上传和下载的延 迟。 此选项未提到如何处理跨地域用户的性能问题。
explanations.C: Use Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling and Amazon CloudFront to host the application. 错误：虽然Amazon CloudFront可以优化内容分发，但EC2实例并不适合直接处理大规模的文件上传和下载需求。 EC2的成本可能高于S3，目需要更多的管理工作。
explanations.D: Use Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling and Amazon ElastiCache to host the application. 错误：Amazon ElastiCache主要用于优化数据库查询或应用程序缓存，并不适合处理文件上传和下载的性能优化。 此选项未提到如何处理跨地域用户的性能问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has hired a solutions architect to design a reliable architecture for its application. The application consists of one Amazon RDS DB instance and two manually provisioned Amazon EC2 instances that run web servers. The EC2 instances are located in a single Availability Zone. An employee recently deleted the DB instance, and the application was unavailable for 24 hours as a result. The company is concerned with the overall reliability of its environment. What should the solutions architect do to maximize reliability of the application's infrastructure?

options.A: Delete one EC2 instance and enable termination protection on the other EC2 instance. Update the DB instance to be Multi- AZ, and enable deletion protection.
options.B: Update the DB instance to be Multi-AZ, and enable deletion protection. Place the EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer, and run them in an EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones.
options.C: Create an additional DB instance along with an Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function. Configure the application to invoke the Lambda function through API Gateway. Have the Lambda function write the data to the two DB instances.
options.D: Place the EC2 instances in an EC2 Auto Scaling group that has multiple subnets located in multiple Availability Zones. Use Spot Instances instead of On-Demand Instances. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor the health of the instances Update the DB instance to be Multi-AZ, and enable deletion protection.

explanations.A: 删除一个 EC2 实例，并在另一个 EC2 实例上启用终止保护。将 DB 实例更新为 Multi-AZ，并启用删除保护。 正确性：启用RDS的Multi-AZ和删除保护是正确的，可以提高数据寑的可靠性并防止人为删除。 错误性：删除一个EC2实例并启用终止保护无法解决单点故障问题，目没有跨多个可用区的高可用性设计。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 将 DB 实例更新为 Multi-AZ，并启用删除保护。将 EC2 实例置于 Application Load Balancer 后面，并在跨多个可用区的 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中运行它们。 正确性：启用RDS的Multi-AZ和删除保护可以提高数据寑的可靠性。使用Application Load Balancer和跨多个可用区的Auto Scaling 组可以确保EC2实例的高可用性。 错误性：无明显错误，设计全面目符合高可用性要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 创建一个额外的 DB 实例以及一个 Amazon API Gateway 和一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置应用程序通过 API Gateway 调用 Lambda 函数。让 Lambda 函数将数据写入两个 DB 实例。 正确性：使用API Gateway和Lambda可以实现无服务器架构，但这与题目要求的可靠性设计不完全相关。 错误性：创建额外的DB实例并通过Lambda写入数据并不能解决人为删除问题，也没有解决EC2实例的高可用性问题。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 将 EC2 实例置于具有多个位于多个可用区的子网的 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中。使用 Spot Instances 而不是 On-Demand Instances。设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以监控实例的健康状况。将 DB 实例更新为 Multi-AZ，并启用删除保护。 正确性：启用RDS的Multi-AZ和删除保护是正确的。使用Auto Scaling组跨多个可用区也可以提高EC2实例的可靠性。 错误性：使用Spot Instances可能会导致实例随时被中断，不适合关键任务应用。题目要求的是可靠性，而不是成本优化。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is storing 700 terabytes of data on a large network-attached storage (NAS) system in its corporate data center. The company has a hybrid environment with a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. After an audit from a regulator, the company has 90 days to move the data to the cloud. The company needs to move the data efficiently and without disruption. The company still needs to be able to access and update the data during the transfer window. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync agent in the corporate data center. Create a data transfer task Start the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Back up the data to AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Ship the devices to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system.
options.C: Use rsync to copy the data directly from local storage to a designated Amazon S3 bucket over the Direct Connect connection.
options.D: Back up the data on tapes. Ship the tapes to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system.

explanations.A: Create an AWS DataSync agent in the corporate data center. Create a data transfer task. Start the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确：AWS DataSync是一种高效的数据迁移服务，支持从本地NAS系统到Amazon S3的迁移。 支持增量迁移，允许在迁移过程中继续访问和更新数据。 通过10 Gbps Direct Connect连接，可以实现快速传输。
explanations.B: Back up the data to AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Ship the devices to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system. 错误：AWS Snowball适用于离线数据迁移，但不支持在迁移过程中访问和更新数据。 需要将设备运送到AWS数据中心，可能会导致迁移时间超过90天的限制。
explanations.C: Use rsync to copy the data directly from local storage to a designated Amazon S3 bucket over the Direct Connect connection. 错误：虽然rsync可以通过Direct Connect进行数据传输，但它不适合处理大规模数据（700 TB）的高效迁移。 缺乏自动化和增量迁移功能，可能会导致迁移过程复杂目耗时。
explanations.D: Back up the data on tapes. Ship the tapes to an AWS data center. Mount a target Amazon S3 bucket on the on-premises file system. 错误：磁带备份是一种传统的离线迁移方法，不支持在迁移过程中访问和更新数据。 运输磁带到AWS数据中心可能会导致迁移时间超过90天的限制。

question: Topic 1 A company stores data in PDF format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must follow a legal requirement to retain all new and existing data in Amazon S3 for 7 years. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Turn on the S3 Versioning feature for the S3 bucket. Configure S3 Lifecycle to delete the data after 7 years. Configure multi- factor authentication (MFA) delete for all S3 objects.
options.B: Turn on S3 Object Lock with governance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.C: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.

explanations.A: 启用S3 Versioning功能并配置S3 Lifecycle删除数据，启用MFA删除： 错误：虽然S3 Versioning可以保留对象的多个版本，但它无法满足法律要求的不可变性（防止删除或修改）。 错误：S3 Lifecycle删除数据后无法保证数据的不可变性，目MFA删除仅用于防止未经授权的删除操作，并不满足法律要求的7年不 可变性。
explanations.B: 启用S3 Object Lock的治理模式并设置保留期限为7年，重新复制现有对象： 部分正确：治理模式允许管理员痩社锁定，但这可能不完全符合法律要求的不可变性。 错误：重新复制现有对象的操作复杂度较高，增加了操作开销。
explanations.C: 启用S3 Object Lock的合规模式并设置保留期限为7年，重新复制现有对象： 部分正确：合规模式可以完全防止对象被删除或修改，符合法律要求。 错误：重新复制现有对象的操作复杂度较高，增加了操作开销。
explanations.D: 启用S3 Object Lock的合规模式并设置保留期限为7年，使用S3 Batch Operations使现有数据符合要求： 正确：合规模式完全防止对象被删除或修改，符合法律要求。 正确：使用S3 Batch Operations可以批量处理现有对象，减少操作开销，符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has a stateless web application that runs on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions to provide Regional failover capabilities. What should a solutions architect do to route traffic to multiple Regions?

options.A: Create Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region. Use an active-active failover configuration.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin for each Region. Use CloudFront health checks to route traffic.
options.C: Create a transit gateway. Attach the transit gateway to the API Gateway endpoint in each Region. Configure the transit gateway to route requests.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer in the primary Region. Set the target group to point to the API Gateway endpoint hostnames in each Region.

explanations.A: Create Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region. Use an active-active failover configuration. 正确：Route 53支持跨区域流量路由，并可以通过健康桌查和主动-主动故障转移配置实现高可用性。 Route 53的健康桌查可以监控桹个区域的API Gateway端点栓态，并根据健康桌查结果动态调整流量路由。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin for each Region. Use CloudFront health checks to route traffic. 错误：虽然CloudFront可以分发流量，但它的健康桌查功能主要用于监控源站的可用性，而不是跨区域流量路由。 CloudFront不支持主动-主动故障转移配置。
explanations.C: Create a transit gateway. Attach the transit gateway to the API Gateway endpoint in each Region. Configure the transit gateway to route requests. 错误：Transit Gateway主要用于VPC之间的网络连接，而不是跨区域流量路由。 API Gateway是无服务器服务，与Transit Gateway的功能不匹配。
explanations.D: Create an Application Load Balancer in the primary Region. Set the target group to point to the API Gateway endpoint hostnames in each Region. 错误：Application Load Balancer是区域性服务，无法直接实现跨区域流量路由。 API Gateway端点主机名无法作为ALB的目标组，因为ALB主要用于负载均衡EC2实例或容器。

question: Topic 1 A company has two VPCs named Management and Production. The Management VPC uses VPNs through a customer gateway to connect to a single device in the data center. The Production VPC uses a virtual private gateway with two attached AWS Direct Connect connections. The Management and Production VPCs both use a single VPC peering connection to allow communication between the applications. What should a solutions architect do to mitigate any single point of failure in this architecture?

options.A: Add a set of VPNs between the Management and Production VPCs.
options.B: Add a second virtual private gateway and attach it to the Management VPC.
options.C: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device.
options.D: Add a second VPC peering connection between the Management VPC and the Production VPC.

explanations.A: Add a set of VPNs between the Management and Production VPCs. 错误：VPC Peering已经存在于Management和Production VPC之间，添加VPN连接不会解决单点故障问题。 VPN连接的主要作用是跨网络连接，而不是解决单点故障。
explanations.B: Add a second virtual private gateway and attach it to the Management VPC. 错误：Management VPC已经通过VPN连接到数据中心，添加第二个虚拟私有网关不会解决单点故障问题。 虚拟私有网关主要用于Direct Connect，而不是VPN连接。
explanations.C: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device. 正确：当前Management VPC通过单个客户网关设备连接到数据中心，这存在单点故障风险。 添加第二组VPN连接并使用第二个客户网关设备可以提高宛余性，解决单点故障问题。
explanations.D: Add a second VPC peering connection between the Management VPC and the Production VPC. 错误：VPC Peering本质上是高可用的，添加第二个VPC Peering连接没有意义。 单点故障问题主要在Management VPC与数据中心的连接，而不是VPC Peering。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its application on an Oracle database. The company plans to quickly migrate to AWS because of limited resources for the database, backup administration, and data center maintenance. The application uses third-party database features that require privileged access. Which solution will help the company migrate the database to AWS MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Replace third-party features with cloud services.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by rewriting the application code to remove dependency on Oracle APEX.

explanations.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Replace third-party features with cloud services. 错误：Amazon RDS for Oracle是一个托管服务，但它不支持对数据库进行深度自定义或访问底层操作系统，这意味着无法支持需要 特权访问的第三方功能。 此外，蔡换第三方功能可能需要额外的开发工作，增加了迁移的复杂性。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features. 正确：Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle允许用户对数据库进行深度自定义，并支持需要特权访问的第三方功能。 这是一个托管服务，减少了数据库管理的负担，同时支持特定的自定义需求。 成本效益较高，因为它结合了托管服务的便利性和自定义能力。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features. 错误：虽然在EC2上运行Oracle数据库可以提供完全的自定义能力，但它需要用户自己管理数据库、备份和底层基础设施。 这增加了管理复杂性和成本，不符合题目中“有限资源”的要求。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by rewriting the application code to remove dependency on Oracle APEX. 错误：将数据库迁移到PostgreSQL需要重写应用程序代码，这是一项复杂目耗时的任务。 此外，题目中没有提到需要迁移到PostgreSQL的具体需求。

question: Topic 1 A company has a three-tier web application that is in a single server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. The company also wants the application to align with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and to be consistent with AWS recommended best practices for security, scalability, and resiliency. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones with the application's existing architecture. Host the application with existing architecture on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in each Availability Zone with EC2 Auto Scaling groups. Secure the EC2 instance with security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs).
options.B: Set up security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs) to control access to the database layer. Set up a single Amazon RDS database in a private subnet.
options.C: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones. Refactor the application to host the web tier, application tier, and database tier. Host each tier on its own private subnet with Auto Scaling groups for the web tier and application tier.
options.D: Use a single Amazon RDS database. Allow database access only from the application tier security group.
options.E: Use Elastic Load Balancers in front of the web tier. Control access by using security groups containing references to each layers security groups.
options.F: Use an Amazon RDS database Multi-AZ cluster deployment in private subnets. Allow database access only from application tier security groups.

explanations.A: 创建一个跨两个可用区的 VPC，使用应用程序的现有架构。在每个可用区的私有子网中使用 EC2 Auto Scaling 组托管现有架构 的应用程序。使用安全组和网络访问控制列表（network ACLs）保护 EC2 实例。 错误：虽然跨两个可用区的VPC是符合高可用性要求的，但“使用应用程序的现有架构”并未提到分宔设计，目未明确提到重构为三 宔架构，不符合AWS Well-Architected Framework的最佳实践。
explanations.B: 设置安全组和网络访问控制列表（network ACLs）以控制对数据库层的访问。在私有子网中设置一个单一的 Amazon RDS 数据 库。 错误：虽然使用安全组和网络ACL控制访问是正确的，但单一的Amazon RDS数据寑未提到Multi-AZ部署，不符合高可用性要求。
explanations.C: 创建一个跨两个可用区的 VPC。重构应用程序以托管 Web 层、应用程序层和数据库层。将每一层托管在其自己的私有子网中， 并为 Web 层和应用程序层设置 Auto Scaling 组。 正确：跨两个可用区的VPC提供高可用性，分宔架构符合AWS Well-Architected Framework的最佳实践，Auto Scaling组提供了可扩 展性。
explanations.D: 使用一个单一的 Amazon RDS 数据库。仅允许应用程序层安全组访问数据库。 错误：单一的Amazon RDS数据寑未提到Multi-AZ部署，不符合高可用性要求。
explanations.E: 在 Web 层前使用 Elastic Load Balancers。通过包含对每一层安全组引用的安全组来控制访问。 正确：Elastic Load Balancer提供了负载均衡功能，符合高可用性和可扩展性要求，使用安全组控制访问符合安全性最佳实践。
explanations.F: 在私有子网中使用 Amazon RDS 数据库 Multi-AZ 集群部署。仅允许应用程序层安全组访问数据库。 正确：Multi-AZ部署提供了高可用性，私有子网和安全组控制访问符合安全性最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating its applications and databases to the AWS Cloud. The company will use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), AWS Direct Connect, and Amazon RDS. Which activities will be managed by the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.A: Management of the Amazon RDS infrastructure layer, operating system, and platforms
options.B: Creation of an Amazon RDS DB instance and configuring the scheduled maintenance window
options.C: Configuration of additional software components on Amazon ECS for monitoring, patch management, log management, and host intrusion detection ££ Amazon ECS
options.D: Installation of patches for all minor and major database versions for Amazon RDS 73 Amazon RDS
options.E: Ensure the physical security of the Amazon RDS infrastructure in the data center
options.F: Encryption of the data that moves in transit through Direct Connect

explanations.A: Management of the Amazon RDS infrastructure layer, operating system, and platforms 错误。根据AWS的Shared Responsibility Model，Amazon RDS的基础设施层、操作系统和平台由AWS负责管理，用户无需管理这些部分。
explanations.B: Creation of an Amazon RDS DB instance and configuring the scheduled maintenance window 正确。用户负责创建 Amazon RDS数据库实例并配置计划维护窗口，这是用户的操作责任。
explanations.C: Configuration of additional software components on Amazon ECS for monitoring, patch management, log management, and host intrusion detection 正确。用户需要在Amazon ECS上配置额外的软件组件，例如监控、补丁管理、日志 管理和主机入侵桌测，这属于用户的责任。
explanations.D: Installation of patches for all minor and major database versions for Amazon RDS 错误。AWS负责为Amazon RDS安装所 有档要和主要数据库标本的补丁，用户无需管理这些部分。
explanations.E: Ensure the physical security of the Amazon RDS infrastructure in the data center 错误。AWS负责数据中心的栌理安全，用 户无需管理这些部分。
explanations.F: Encryption of the data that moves in transit through Direct Connect 正确。用户需要负责通过Direct Connect加密传输中的 数据，这是用户的责任。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a Java-based job on an Amazon EC2 instance. The job runs every hour and takes 10 seconds to run. The job runs on a scheduled interval and consumes 1 GB of memory. The CPU utilization of the instance is low except for short surges during which the job uses the maximum CPU available. The company wants to optimize the costs to run the job. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS App2Container (A2C) to containerize the job. Run the job as an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task on AWS Fargate with 0.5 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 1 GB of memory.
options.B: Copy the code into an AWS Lambda function that has 1 GB of memory. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to run the code each hour.
options.C: Use AWS App2Container (A2C) to containerize the job. Install the container in the existing Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Ensure that the schedule stops the container when the task finishes.
options.D: Configure the existing schedule to stop the EC2 instance at the completion of the job and restart the EC2 instance when the next job starts.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 将任务容器化。将任务作为 Amazon ECS 上的任务运行，使用 AWS Fargate 配置 0.5 虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 和 1 GB 内存。 正确性分析：AWS Fargate是无服务器的容器运行服务，适合运行容器化任务。但对于一个运行时间仅10秒的任务，使用Fargate可 能会导致额外的启动时间和成本开销。 错误原因：虽然可以运行任务，但相比AWS Lambda，Fargate的成本优化不够理想，目任务启动时间可能较长。
explanations.B: 将代码复制到具有 1 GB 内存的 AWS Lambda 函数中。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 定时规则，每小时运行一次代码。 正确性分析：AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，适合运行短时任务。结合Amazon EventBridge可以答案实现定时任务调度。 正确原因：Lambda的启动时间极短，目按使用时间计费，非常适合运行10秒的任务，成本最低。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 将任务容器化。将容器安装到现有的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 中。确保计划在任务完 成时停止容器。 正确性分析：将任务容器化并安装到现有AMI中可以运行任务，但需要额外的管理和调度工作。 错误原因：相比AWS Lambda，这种方法复杂度更高，目无法实现最佳成本优化。
explanations.D: 配置现有计划，在任务完成时停止 EC2 实例，并在下一次任务开始时重新启动 EC2 实例。 正确性分析：通过停止和启动EC2实例可以节省部分成本，但需要额外的管理工作。 错误原因：EC2实例的启动时间较长，目管理复杂度高，不如AWS Lambda直接运行任务高效。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to implement a backup strategy for Amazon EC2 data and multiple Amazon S3 buckets. Because of regulatory requirements, the company must retain backup files for a specific time period. The company must not alter the files for the duration of the retention period. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in governance mode. Create the required backup plan.
options.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create the required automated snapshot policy.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway to create the backup. Configure the appropriate S3 Lifecycle management.
options.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode. Create the required backup plan.

explanations.A: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in governance mode. Create the required backup plan. 治理模式（Governance Mode）允许用户在锁定后仍然可以通过特定权限修改或删除备份文件。 由于题目要求“必须不改变文件”，治理模式不符合要求。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create the required automated snapshot policy. Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager主要用于管理EC2实例的快照生命周期，但无法满足S3数据的备份需求。 此外，它不提供文件不可更改的功能。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway to create the backup. Configure the appropriate S3 Lifecycle management. Amazon S3 File Gateway主要用于将本地文件存储到S3，但它不提供备份文件不可更改的功能。 题目要求“必须不改变文件”，此选项无法满足要求。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode. Create the required backup plan. 合规模式（Compliance Mode）确保备份文件在锁定后无法被修改或删除，完全符合题目要求。 AWS Backup支持EC2和S3的备份，能够满足题目中对两种资源的备份需求。 因此此选项正确。

question: Topic 1 A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A newly hired solutions architect discovers a previous employee did not provide details about the resources inventory. The solutions architect needs to build and map the relationship details of the various workloads across all accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from the detailed view report.
options.B: Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Build architecture diagrams of the workloads manually.
options.C: Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
options.D: Use AWS X-Ray to view the workload details. Build architecture diagrams with relationships.

explanations.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from the detailed view report. 错误：AWS Systems Manager Inventory主要用于收集和管理实例及其相关资源的详痢人息，但它不具备直接生成架构图或跨账 户、跨区域资源关系图的功能。
explanations.B: Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Build architecture diagrams of the workloads manually. 错误：AWS Step Functions是一个编排服务，用于构建工作流。虽然可以用它来收集工作负载人息，但手动构建架构图效率低下， 不符合题目要求的“最具操作效率”的解决方案。
explanations.C: Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads. 正确：Workload Discovery on AWS是一种工具，可以自动发现资源并生成架构图，支持跨账户和跨区域的资源关系映射，非常适 合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS X-Ray to view the workload details. Build architecture diagrams with relationships. 错误：AWS X-Ray主要用于分布式应用程序的性能分析和跟踪，不适合生成跨账户和跨区域的架构图。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS Organizations. The company wants to operate some of its AWS accounts with different budgets. The company wants to receive alerts and automatically prevent provisioning of additional resources on AWS accounts when the allocated budget threshold is met during a specific period. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Cost and Usage Reports section of the required AWS accounts.
options.B: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Billing dashboards of the required AWS accounts.
options.C: Create an IAM user for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions. 73 AWS Budgets
options.D: Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions. 73 AWS Budgets
options.E: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate config rule to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
options.F: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources.

explanations.A: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Cost and Usage Reports section of the required AWS accounts. 错误：AWS Budgets的预算设置并不在“Cost and Usage Reports”部分，而是在Billing Dashboard中进行。此选项描述不准确。
explanations.B: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Billing dashboards of the required AWS accounts. 正确：AWS Budgets的预算创建和设置是在Billing Dashboard中完成的，此选项描述正确。
explanations.C: Create an IAM user for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions. 错误：AWS Budgets通常使用IAM角色而不是IAM用户来执行预算操作。IAM角色更适合跨账户或服务的权限管理。
explanations.D: Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions. 正确：AWS Budgets需要一个IAM角色来执行预算操作，例如触发警报或限制资源创建。此选项描述正确。
explanations.E: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate config rule to prevent provisioning of additional resources. 错误：预算操作通常使用SCP（服务控制策略）来限制资源创建，而不是通过Config规则。此选项描述不准确。
explanations.F: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources. 正确：SCP是AWS Organizations中用于限制账户行为的有效工具，可以防止超出预算的资源创建。此选项描述正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs applications on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region. The company wants to back up the EC2 instances to a second Region. The company also wants to provision EC2 resources in the second Region and manage the EC2 instances centrally from one AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a disaster recovery (DR) plan that has a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Configure data replication.
options.B: Create point-in-time Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots of the EC2 instances. Copy the snapshots to the second Region periodically.
options.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup. Configure cross-Region backup to the second Region for the EC2 instances.
options.D: Deploy a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data from the source Region to the second Region.

explanations.A: 创建一个灾难恢复（DR）计划，在第二个区域内拥有类似数量的 EC2 实例。配置数据复制。 错误：直接在第二个区域部署类似数量的 EC2 实例并配置数据复制会导致高成本，因为需要持续运行额外的 EC2 实例。 不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: 创建 EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）快照。定期将快照复制到第二个区域。 正确：EBS快照可以提供点时间备份，并支持跨区域复制。 但此方法需要手动管理快照复制，缺乏自动化和集中管理功能。 虽然成本较低，但不如AWS Backup的解决方案全面。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份计划。为 EC2 实例配置跨区域备份到第二个区域。 正确：AWS Backup支持自动化备份计划，并可以配置跨区域备份。 提供集中管理功能，符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 这是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: 在第二个区域内部署类似数量的 EC2 实例。使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从源区域传输到第二个区域。 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于文件数据的传输，而不是EC2实例的备份。 此外，部署类似数量的EC2实例会导致高成本，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company that uses AWS is building an application to transfer data to a product manufacturer. The company has its own identity provider (IdP). The company wants the IdP to authenticate application users while the users use the application to transfer data. The company must use Applicability Statement 2 (AS2) protocol. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.B: Use Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task for IdP authentication.
options.C: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool for IdP authentication.

explanations.A: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication. 错误原因：AWS DataSync主要用于在不同存储系统之间高效传输数据，但它不支持AS2协议，也无法直接与IdP集成进行身份验 确。
explanations.B: Use Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task for IdP authentication. 错误原因：Amazon AppFlow用于在AWS服务和SaaS应用之间自动化数据流，但它不支持AS2协议。此外，ECS任务并不是处理IdP 身份验证的最佳选择。
explanations.C: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication. 正确原因：AWS Transfer Family支持AS2协议，可以用于安全的数据传输。通过AWS Lambda，可以实现与公司IdP的集成进行身份 验证。
explanations.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool for IdP authentication. 错误原因：AWS Storage Gateway主要用于混合云存储解决方案，不支持AS2协议。此外，Amazon Cognito虽然可以用于身份验 确，但它与AS2协议的需求不匹配。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a RESTAPI in Amazon API Gateway for a cash payback service. The application requires 1 GB of memory and 2 GB of storage for its computation resources. The application will require that the data is in a relational format. Which additional combination ofAWS services will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Amazon EC2
options.B: AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon RDS
options.D: Amazon DynamoDB
options.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS)

explanations.A: Amazon EC2: Amazon EC2可以提供计算资源和存储，但需要手动管理操作系统、数据库安装和维护，增加了管理复杂性，不符合“最少管理工 作”的要求。因此错误。
explanations.B: AWS Lambda: AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，支持API Gateway集成，但Lambda函数的内存限制为10 GB，目不直接提供持久化存储。虽然满 足计算需求，但无法满足存储需求。因此错误。
explanations.C: Amazon RDS: Amazon RDS是托管的关系型数据库服务，支持存储数据的关系型格式，目管理工作量较少。符合题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.D: Amazon DynamoDB: Amazon DynamoDB是托管的NoSQL数据库服务，不支持关系型数据存储格式，因此错误。
explanations.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS): Amazon EKS可以运行容器化应用，但需要管理容器编排和存储，增加了管理复杂性，不符合“最少管理工作”的要求。因此错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS Organizations to run workloads within multiple AWS accounts. A tagging policy adds department tags to AWS resources when the company creates tags. An accounting team needs to determine spending on Amazon EC2 consumption. The accounting team must determine which departments are responsible for the costs regardless ofAWS account. The accounting team has access to AWS Cost Explorer for all AWS accounts within the organization and needs to access all reports from Cost Explorer. Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2. ££ Organizations
options.B: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2. € Organizations
options.C: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by the tag name, and filter by EC2. ££ Organizations
options.D: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2. £ Organizations

explanations.A: 从Organizations管理账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为department的用户定义成本分配标签。在Cost Explorer中创建一个 成本报告，按标签名称分组，并过滤EC2。 正确：管理账户可以集中管理所有成员账户的成本分配标疮。 正确：用户定义的成本分配标疮可以根据需求自定义，例如“department”。 正确：Cost Explorer支持按标疮分组并过滤资源类型（如EC2）。
explanations.B: 从Organizations管理账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为department的AWS定义成本分配标签。在Cost Explorer中创建一个 成本报告，按标签名称分组，并过滤EC2。 错误：AWS定义的成本分配标疮是由AWS预定义的，无法自定义“department”标疮。 正确：管理账户可以集中管理成本分配标疮。 正确：Cost Explorer支持按标疮分组并过滤资源类型（如EC2）。
explanations.C: 从Organizations成员账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为department的用户定义成本分配标签。在Cost Explorer中创建一个 成本报告，按标签名称分组，并过滤EC2。 错误：成员账户无法集中管理所有账户的成本分配标疮。 正确：用户定义的成本分配标疮可以根据需求自定义，例如“department”。 正确：Cost Explorer支持按标疮分组并过滤资源类型（如EC2）。
explanations.D: 从Organizations成员账户的账单控制台中，激活一个名为department的AWS定义成本分配标签。在Cost Explorer中创建一个 成本报告，按标签名称分组，并过滤EC2。 错误：成员账户无法集中管理所有账户的成本分配标疮。 错误：AWS定义的成本分配标疮是由AWS预定义的，无法自定义“department”标疮。 正确：Cost Explorer支持按标疮分组并过滤资源类型（如EC2）。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to securely exchange data between its software as a service (SaaS) application Salesforce account and Amazon S3. The company must encrypt the data at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys (CMKs). The company must also encrypt the data in transit. The company has enabled API access for the Salesforce account.
